title: DCEO Chief Engineer, ADC InfraOps DCEO
description:
Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

This technical leadership position brings a 24/7 presence to support the engineering operations technicians on site and to be available to respond to site specific needs

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
• Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.
• Operate independently with limited direct management
• Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed, and work OT hours as needed to support site stability.
• Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
• Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
• Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
• Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience
Physical Requirements:
• Walk job sites in uneven terrain
• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
• Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
• Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
• Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
• Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
• Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
• Push or pull heavy objects into position
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work at depths, such as under raised floors

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Part-Time Archive Assistant
description:
Come work with us at Houston Ballet!
Join a leading nonprofit arts organization that’s redefining what ballet can be. The purpose of the Archive Project is to safeguard the legacy of Houston Ballet and implement systems that will streamline the usage, creation, and storage of archival documents across the organization. The primary components of the project are: 1) completion of inventory of the collection and implementation of a long-term project to create a searchable catalog for archival materials; 2) archival-quality digitization of prioritized analog video materials; and 3) improved systems for accessing and preserving archival materials used in the company's daily activities, including creation of manuals, workflows, and protocols.

•ALA-accredited Masters in Library Science or combination of relevant education and experience;
•Demonstrated success in completing large-scale multi-format archival processing projects;
•Project management experience: ability to track progress toward multiple goals, meet milestones, supervise assistants and work as part of a team;
•Strong grasp of metadata and content standards; familiarity with archival database design, platforms, cataloging, and data migration;
•Familiarity with analog video formats and digital file formats, strong grasp of audiovisual and digital preservation standards and best practices in digital asset management;
•Excellent communication skills and attention to detail;
•Knowledge of and interest in dance and issues in documentation and preservation of dance or performing arts preferred.
Work Environment:

title: Solutions Architect - AWS WWPS DoW, US Navy Solutions Architecture
description:

title: CLS I (VARIABLE)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Analyzes specimens and performs laboratory testing procedures in accordance with established and approved protocol, which require the exercise and independent judgment and interpretation. Must be able to perform jobs in all patient care and operational areas subject to reasonable accommodations, also be able to employ all mandatory safety devices and procedures. This is a union position.

Completes all Pre-Analytical Responsibilities

  • Biological specimen collection including; patient preparation, labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, inoculation, subculturing or staining, transportation and storage of specimens, receives collects and delivers to appropriate departments. Confirms completeness of the test requisition and tests orders
  • Verifies specimens are labeled accurately and that minimal labeling requirements are met.
  • Verifies specimen type and integrity, identifies, researches and corrects routine problems.
  • Checks for specimen source or site for microbiology samples
  • Verifies specimen collection date and time.
  • Checks for duplication collections. Example: One blood culture set per draw site.
  • Accessions specimens into the laboratory computer system, recording accurate collection time and specimen.
  • Prepares specimens for analysis while maintaining correct and complete identification and using appropriate centrifuge methods to ensure specimen quality.
  • Follows through and documents non-blood specimen collection, prepares collection material, measures specimens, records and forwards pertinent information necessary for the accurate calculation of the test results.
  • Biological specimen collection, including patient preparation, labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, inoculation, subculturing or staining and transportation and storage of specimen
  • Utilizes materials and procedures required for quality control of testing processes adhering to established laboratory protocol and/or Westgard rules.
  • Must know operational procedure for the Computerized Tube System.

Completes all Analytical Responsibilities

  • Analyzes specimens following standard methods and procedures. Performing testing in accordance with assigned section policies and procedures i.e. Coagulation, Chemistry, Hematology/ Serology, Body Fluids/ Urinalysis, Transfusion Service, and Microbiology.
  • Assists with testing in all departments as necessary to maintain optimum processing of results. Demonstrates ability to set priorities. Adheres to laboratory policy concerning STAT testing, delta checks, critical values and abnormal values. Telephones or faxes results as appropriate within the acceptable time frame.
  • Makes decisions involving test validity, monitoring testing for deviation from acceptable limits, is able to initiate retesting when required and alerts Laboratory Director or Supervisor of errors or shortcomings in the testing processes.
  • Responds to changes in work as required, assisting with testing in all depts as necessary to maintain optimum processing of results.
  • Must know down time procedure for both the computer and instrumentation and the process for reporting computer problems on the off shifts. Must be familiar with send out procedures for after hour transport of send out testing. Must know the send out procedure for down instrumentation.

Completes all Post-Analytical Responsibilities

  • Maintains laboratory records, log sheets, worksheets and paper work. Documents and signs work acknowledging responsibility. Reviews pending logs at the end of the shift to determine status of incomplete work. Prepares the End of Shift Report (EOSR) and communicates with staff on the next shift to make sure there are no gaps in service.
  • Ensure that telephone calls are answered and that all reports are reported in a timely manner.
  • Handle customer service complaints and intercede to correct problems, resolving issues that can be dealt with and communicating with Supervisor all client service and employee issues that need further attention.

Completes all Department Responsibilities

  • Performs instrument / equipment preventative maintenance procedures as required, documenting and reporting malfunctions to Laboratory Director or Supervisor.
  • Inspect equipment, troubleshoot failures and take corrective action as necessary, calling for instrument technical service as required.
  • Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with all levels of staff within the laboratory, nursing staff, and physicians. Contributes to teamwork and harmonious working relationships by communicating effectively and appropriately to resolve problems. Must be able to carryout instructions while working alone with little supervision.
  • Monitors inventory in all lab departments, making sure supplies are restocked, ordered and/ or put away.
  • Participates in the proficiency testing surveys including specimen preparation, analysis, and reporting, and additionally participates in annual competency testing for all departments.
  • Oversees and delegates duties to the Laboratory Technical Assistant (LTA) including but not limited to: quality control, calibration, linearity, calibration verification setup, inventory, ordering, and maintenance, troubleshooting and testing of proficiency surveys. The duties should be coordinated with a teamwork approach.
  • Actively cross-train in all eight (8) disciplines performed by the laboratory.
  • Demonstrates competency in all eight (8) disciplines performed by the laboratory within one (1) year of employment.
  • Master's one general laboratory section, (blood bank).
  • Demonstrates the ability to resolve technical situations at a basic level, referring complicated situations to another CLS I, or CLS II, CLS III, Supervisor, or Director.
  • Must be able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of staff within the laboratory.
  • Takes an active role in providing training and assists new personnel in department orientation. Acts as a resource for new personnel.
  • Assists CLS Supervisor in the coordination and training of CLS and MLT students.
  • Demonstrates and supports the integrated automated Core Laboratory operations and its mission to provide patient test information accurately and efficiently to the caregivers of the hospital, which impacts value base purchasing.
  • Demonstrates and supports working with the hospital and the Core Laboratory in raising efficiency, productivity, and reducing operating cost and waste.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About us

Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we’ve since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence.

For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology.

At our core, we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it’s how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you’ll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we’re shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world.

Why join us?

At Love, Bonito, you’ll do more than just a job — you’ll help build a movement. We’re creating an organization that’s lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Purpose with performance: We’re building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence. Join us if you take customer service excellence seriously and are passionate about creating real impact!
  • Growth that’s real: We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You’ll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure. Don’t join us if you’re looking for a comfortable, fully structured setup, but do join us if you’re excited to build, shape, and make an impact together!
  • Culture at our core: If you’re looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, you’ll fit right in. We lead with empathy, celebrate individuality, and believe that great work comes from trust, not titles. We believe in teamwork and effective collaboration - because when we run together, we go further. If this speaks to your values, come join us and be part of #TeamLB!

Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring global consumer group.

About the role

Reporting to the Senior Data Engineer, this role is based in ID and owns the analytical backbone of how Love, Bonito makes decisions – from self-serve reporting to forecasting models that tell us what to expect and where to focus next.

Main responsibilities

1. Dashboard & Reporting

  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance dashboards that enable stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Define and own the metrics layer (clear, documented definitions) so numbers don’t silently diverge across teams
  • Set and enforce dashboarding best practices (design standards, naming conventions, template library) across the analytics function
  • Document SOPs for dashboard build, refresh, and handover so ownership can transfer without loss of context

2. Forecasting & Modeling

  • Build and ship production-grade forecasting models for run-rate and sales-event performance, tracked against actuals
  • Use forecasting output to inform campaign mechanics

3. Customer Analytics

  • Build and maintain customer segmentation and market basket analyses to uncover cross-sell opportunities
  • Deliver reusable, scalable analytical frameworks, not one‑off answers to one‑off questions

4. Governance

  • Own model documentation: assumptions, limitations and decision boundaries for any model that influences spend decisions

5. Technical Optimization

  • Evaluate and optimise aggregation tables for performance and scalability
  • Automate recurring workflows to reduce manual effort and reduce time-to-insight

6. Data Modeling & Pipeline Architecture

  • Design table structures (fact/dimension modeling, partition strategy) for scalability and query performance – architecting new tables, not just tuning existing one
  • Own orchestration and scheduling of recurring pipelines (e.g. Airflow, dbt, Databricks Workflows) including failure monitoring and data‑freshness SLAs

7. Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Document data models and business logic so solutions are maintainable by other team members and usable as context by internal AI tooling

Who We Are Looking For:

We're hiring for someone who has already shipped production work

  • Statistical first-principles grounding: understands identification assumptions, confounding, and bias‑variance tradeoffs well enough to choose a method because it fits the problem, not because it reaches the default reach
  • Has shipped at least one model or evaluation pipeline to production and can speak to what broke, how it was monitored, and how false positives were ruled out

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering) or related discipline; Master’s a plus
  • 1-3 years of relevant experience with demonstrated production ownership of at least one pipeline, model or dashboard suite
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, statistics
  • Deep proficiency in Tableau (or equivalent BI tool) — able to set and enforce dashboarding best practices, not just build to spec
  • Pipeline orchestration/scheduling experience (Airflow, dbt or equivalent)
  • Data modeling experience (dimensional modeling/star schema or equivalent)
  • Self‑starter who proactively finds and closes optimisation gaps
  • Comfortable using modern analytics/AI tooling to move faster
  • Collaborative team player who takes ownership and drives projects to completion

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to causal inference or incrementality measurement (difference‑in‑differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling) — a genuine plus if you have it, not required to apply
  • Familiarity with modern data lakehouse/lakebase (Databricks/GCP experience a plus)

title: Software Development Engineer, S3 Glacier
description:
The vast majority of data in the world is cold -- durably and securely retained for long periods of time, but rarely ever accessed. Conventional storage systems are a poor fit for this domain as they are typically optimized for speed rather than space and cost. Amazon Glacier has been designed from the very start to provide secure, durable and scalable data storage at a very low cost. This unusual set of constraints requires us to solve fascinating scaling and algorithmic problems that have never been tackled at our scale.

Amazon S3 Glacier is a secure, durable, and extremely low-cost cloud storage service for data archiving and long-term backup. Customers use Glacier to store data long term, while having the flexibility of retrieving their data within a few minutes using Expedited retrieval speed or a few hours using Standard or Bulk retrieval speeds. Conventional storage systems are a poor fit for this domain as they are typically optimized for speed rather than space and cost. Glacier's unique constraints lead to to fascinating scaling and algorithmic problems that have never been tackled at our scale. To meet our cost and availability goals, we have a constant need to drive fundamentally new storage technologies in the industry and come up with innovative ways to further optimize cost and availability. We are now working on the next set of major hardware and software enhancements to the service and are seeking a Software Development Engineer to join our experienced team.

As an engineer on the Glacier Foundational and Customer analytics services team, you'll work to develop the Glacier control plane, core components, customer analytics and achieving a consistent and highly available customer retrieval experience. To do so, you'll need to solve challenging computer science problems and to drive operational excellence. We are looking for an engineer who is keen to lead, invent in this space, and build what could become the largest data storage service on the planet.

description:
Purpose:

The Aircraft Dispatcher reports to the Director – Flight Dispatch and is delegated authority by the Director of Operations to execute Operational Control duties for the initiation, continuation, diversion, and termination of air carrier flight operations and may be authorized duties under Part 135 On Demand, Part 121 Supplemental Operations, or both. Aircraft Dispatchers assess every variable that may affect safety of flight based on aircraft type, route, weather, and other factors and confirm each flight’s compliance with all applicable Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs), Operations Specifications (OpSpecs), and company flight operational policies and procedures.

Duties:

  • Executes delegated authority from the Director of Operations to issue Flight Releases in accordance with company policies, procedures, and FARs.
  • Plans each flight with primary emphasis on Safety, Compliance, and schedule continuity.
  • Analyzes and evaluates information regarding weather and airport conditions to anticipate changes that may affect flight operations.
  • Computes fuel requirements according to type of aircraft, distance, weather conditions, destination alternates(s), and FARs.
  • Prepares flight plans and issues flight releases containing such information as maximum allowable takeoff and landing weights, weather reports, field conditions, METARs, TAFs, NOTAMs, PIREPs, and other information required for the safe completion of the flight.
  • Assists the Pilot in Command (PIC) of an aircraft with any emergency by providing the assistance necessary to ensure the safe completion of the flight.
  • Monitors the progress of each flight to ensure release compliance with flight release, updates flight crew of significant changes to weather or flight plan and recommends alternative courses of action in the interest of safety as needed.
  • Authorized to delay or divert a flight if unsafe conditions pose a threat to the safety of the crew members, aircraft, cargo, or flight.
  • Follows company procedures and exercises conservative judgement in determining when to escalate communications and decision-making up through the chain-of-command, including up to the Director of Operations, when safety concerns arise or compliance with FARs or policy and procedures is in question.
  • Maintains competency by passing all oral, written, and practical competency checks, including Initial and Recurrent training events and general company training.

Unique Skills:

title: AI infra GTM Specialist, Service Specialist Orgnization
description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Would you like to be the person who ensures the AI infrastructure ambitions of CMHK customers translate into real workloads running on AWS? As a Go-to-Market Specialist (GTMS) for AI Infrastructure, you are the connective tissue between CMHK customers, field account teams, and global AWS service teams. You own the go-to-market motion for AWS's AI infrastructure portfolio — EC2 GPU instances, SageMaker AI, and Trainium — and your job is to make adoption happen: bring the voice of the customer to service teams, equip field teams to win, and keep everything oriented toward workloads actually landing and running.

You operate at the intersection of customers and builders. Half your time is spent with customers and account teams — understanding their AI training and inference roadmaps, shaping commercial structures, and unblocking the path to deployment. The other half is spent working across global WWSO and service teams — carrying CMHK market requirements into product and capacity decisions, driving feature prioritization, and ensuring the global machine moves for your customers. You are neither pure field nor pure product; you are the person who holds the full picture and makes sure no part of the chain drops.

You do not just sell a service — you see the entire value chain from capacity planning through commercial negotiation to workload go-live, and you orchestrate the right people at the right time to make each stage succeed. You combine market awareness of the GPU and accelerator ecosystem with the commercial instincts to structure deals and the operational rigor to drive them to closure. Success is measured in workloads landed, revenue closed, and customers scaled — not in meetings held or decks produced.

The ideal candidate understands the AI infrastructure market at a structural level — supply dynamics, chip economics, competitive positioning — and can translate that understanding into actionable GTM plans. You should be comfortable discussing instance selection and capacity models with a customer's ML platform team, then turning around to build a business case that moves a service-team leader to prioritize a regional requirement. You are self-driven, commercially sharp, and relentless about outcomes.

What Makes This Role Different
Beyond the standard GTMS mandate, we are hiring against four differentiating capabilities. Candidates will be assessed explicitly against each.

1. Market and ecosystem fluency in AI infrastructure
You understand the AI infrastructure landscape — not just AWS's portfolio, but the broader GPU and accelerator chip ecosystem, supply-demand dynamics, competitive alternatives, and how customers make build-vs-buy and chip-selection decisions. You track market shifts (new silicon generations, capacity constraints, pricing movements) and translate them into GTM implications. This is not about being a chip engineer; it is about having the commercial and strategic literacy to advise customers and position AWS credibly in a fast-moving market.

2. Full-stack GTM ownership with a workload-landing mindset
You do not consider a deal closed when a contract is signed — you think in terms of workloads running in production. You hold the mental model of the entire customer journey: from initial engagement through commercial negotiation, capacity securing, onboarding, and production scale-up. While you do not personally execute every step, you ensure nothing falls between the cracks. You coordinate SA, CSM, and service-team resources like a program leader, and you escalate or intervene when progress stalls. Your north star is adoption, not booking.

3. Commercial acumen and deal-shaping ability
You bring genuine business negotiation skills. You understand how to structure AI infrastructure engagements — commitment models, pricing levers, capacity reservations — and you work with account teams to shape deals that are compelling for the customer and sound for AWS. You are not a bystander in commercial discussions; you actively craft the offer, quantify the value, and help close.

4. Influence across boundaries — customer, field, and service teams
This role lives at the seams of the organization. You must earn trust and drive action in three directions simultaneously: with customers who need to believe AWS can deliver at their scale, with field teams who need your expertise to win, and with global service teams who need to be convinced that a CMHK requirement deserves priority. You build relationships fast, communicate with clarity and conviction, and push things to resolution rather than letting them queue. When something is stuck, you diagnose whether the blocker is technical, commercial, or political — and you drive the specific action to clear it.

Key job responsibilities
Customer Engagement & Demand Shaping

Engage directly with CMHK customers' AI/ML platform teams and decision-makers to understand their training and inference roadmaps, infrastructure preferences, and adoption timelines; build trusted relationships that give you early, accurate signal on where demand is heading.

Translate customer requirements into structured asks — capacity needs, feature gaps, commercial constraints — and carry them with context and conviction to global service teams and WWSO, ensuring the customer's voice lands with specificity rather than abstraction.

Go-to-Market Execution & Deal Progression

Own the end-to-end GTM motion for the AWS AI infrastructure portfolio in CMHK — define the positioning, build the pipeline, and drive opportunities from qualification through closure in partnership with field account teams.

Shape deal structures with commercial acumen: advise on commitment models, capacity reservations, pricing levers, and engagement terms that balance customer value with AWS economics; be a hands-on participant in commercial negotiations, not a sideline observer.

Maintain a workload-landing orientation throughout the deal lifecycle — ensure that every closed opportunity has a credible path to production deployment, and orchestrate SA, CSM, and service-team resources to remove blockers before they stall adoption.

Market Intelligence & Ecosystem Awareness

Maintain current, defensible knowledge of the AI infrastructure market — GPU supply dynamics, accelerator chip roadmaps (NVIDIA, AWS custom silicon, competitive alternatives), pricing trends, and how customers evaluate build-vs-buy decisions across the ecosystem.

Translate market intelligence into actionable GTM guidance for account teams: which customers to prioritize, which workloads to target, where AWS has a right-to-win versus where competitive positioning requires a different approach.

Prove a repeatable GTM motion on a real customer win, codify it, and transfer it to the broader field so that one successful landing pattern becomes a scalable playbook for AI infrastructure adoption.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for leading quality improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations, suppliers, and customer-facing quality issues. This position serves as a technical leader for problem-solving activities, drives corrective and preventive actions, and ensures compliance with customer-specific requirements, ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and company quality standards. The Senior Quality Engineer partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customers to improve product quality, reduce defects, and drive continuous improvement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead root cause analysis investigations utilizing methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree Analysis, and other structured problem-solving tools.

  • Facilitate containment, corrective action, and preventive action activities for internal, supplier, and customer quality issues.

  • Analyze quality performance metrics and identify opportunities for process and product improvements.

  • Support new product launches through APQP activities, PFMEA reviews, control plan development, process validation, and PPAP submissions.

  • Lead resolution of customer complaints and warranty issues, ensuring timely responses and effective corrective actions.

  • Conduct process audits, layered process audits, and quality system audits to ensure compliance with established requirements.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to improve process capability, reduce variation, and eliminate defects.

  • Develop and maintain quality documentation including control plans, inspection standards, work instructions, and quality procedures.

  • Work with suppliers to resolve quality concerns, conduct supplier audits, and drive supplier performance improvements.

  • Analyze statistical data and implement Statistical Process Control (SPC) methodologies as appropriate.

  • Support customer visits, audits, and quality reviews.

  • Monitor and report key quality performance indicators including PPM, scrap, rework, warranty claims, and customer scorecards.

  • Facilitate continuous improvement projects utilizing Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles.

  • Assist in training personnel on quality requirements, methodologies, and customer-specific expectations.

  • Support Management Review activities and participate in strategic quality planning initiatives.

  • Mentor junior quality engineers and quality technicians.

title: Plastic Injection Molding Set - Up & Process Tech - IN
description:
Plastic Injection Molding Set-Up & Process Technician

2nd (2:30pm - 11:00pm) & 3rd Shift (10:00pm - 6:30am)

Position Summary

The Plastic Injection Molding Set-Up Technician is responsible for the safe and efficient setup, operation, troubleshooting, and optimization of injection molding machines to produce high-quality plastic components that meet customer specifications. This position plays a key role in maintaining production efficiency, minimizing downtime, and ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical aptitude, experience with mold changes and process adjustments, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Follow all company safety policies and maintain a clean, organized work environment.
  • Set up and prepare injection molding machines for production, including mold installation, startup, and process verification.
  • Program and adjust molding machine parameters to achieve optimal cycle times and product quality.
  • Perform mold changes, machine startups, and production changeovers with minimal downtime.
  • Monitor machine performance throughout production and make process adjustments as needed to maintain quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot machine, tooling, and process issues to minimize downtime and maximize efficiency.
  • Operate injection molding equipment safely and efficiently while meeting production schedules.
  • Inspect molded parts using measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, tape measures, and other precision tools.
  • Perform first-piece inspections and complete all required quality documentation.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, work instructions, job travelers, and process documentation.
  • Dry, prepare, and maintain engineering-grade materials including nylon, acetal, and other thermoplastic resins according to manufacturer specifications.
  • Monitor and maintain proper material moisture content using drying equipment.
  • Blend virgin and regrind materials in accordance with established procedures to ensure product consistency.
  • Identify and correct molding defects including flash, short shots, sink marks, warpage, burns, and dimensional issues.
  • Perform basic preventative maintenance on molding machines, molds, and auxiliary equipment.
  • Assist with mold cleaning, preventive maintenance, and minor tooling repairs as needed.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, productivity, scrap reduction, and cycle time improvements.
  • Crosstrain and assist production operators as required.
  • Maintain accurate production, quality, and maintenance records.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

title: Cloud HW engineer, SI/PI, Network Product Development - Optics
description:
Do you like to use electrical and computer engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Core Networking team is looking for a Sr. Cloud Hardware Development Engineer to join our Network Product Development (NPD) team. As a Sr. Cloud Hardware Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying and scaling the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global data centers.

AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. They own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking’s goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.

Key job responsibilities
Cloud Hardware Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems designs, deployments, operations, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.
• Collaborate with vendors/manufacturers to evaluate new hardware and software features. Create implementations plans for incorporating them into the network.
• Simulate and accurately mode high speed electrical and optical designs
• Automate electrical and optical test plans helping qualifying optical modules.
• Collaborate with vendors/manufactures in defining and developing new electrical and optical components and modules.
• Work with network operations team in identifying operation issues and improving quality and RMA process.

A day in the life
On an everyday basis as part of our team, you have the unique opportunity to understand the growing AWS network and our internal customers’ requirement on interconnect solutions. You'll work backwards to devise hardware solutions by influencing the broad industry and/or to develop software tools with sister teams to maintain a highly available network that delights AWS customers. You design and implement processes and mechanisms that both help the team to deliver business impact to the organization in a systemic way, while also helping to raise the bar on our operational excellence.
Operating at the scale we do, there is no blueprint for how to do what we do, which encourages our engineers to identify and develop simple solutions to complex problems. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. We work closely with our internal partners that design, build and operate the network to ensure that our solutions meet their needs and exceed their expectations.

Within AWS Networking the NPD (Network Product Development) organization is responsible for, designing the hardware, building the software, and owning the interconnects for the routers that power the global AWS network. Beyond product delivery we actively manage the fleet or routers in a network that grows by 70% annually. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Cloud Management Foundations
description:
Have you ever wondered how Amazon manages its own presence in the cloud? Amazon is one of AWS's largest customers, and here in the Amazon Cloud Management Foundations (ACMF) organization, we architect and build the services that govern how Amazonians access, organize, and operate their AWS accounts. We work with customers and peers from the entire range of Amazon's businesses to drive initiatives in AWS.

Our team owns the governance layer for Amazon's cloud infrastructure. We define how thousands of AWS accounts are classified, how access policies are enforced, and how teams across Amazon operate within a consistent, secure framework. Our services underpin every Amazon business, from e-Commerce to Prime, Alexa, and Prime Video.

We are building the next generation of enterprise account governance for Amazon. This means rethinking how accounts are described, how policies are applied, and how guardrails scale with Amazon's growth. If you want to shape the future of how one of the world's largest cloud environments is governed, you've found the right place.

As a Technical Program Manager at ACMF, you will own the program strategy for enterprise account governance across Amazon. You'll define the vision for how governance policies, account classification, and access controls evolve to meet the needs of Amazon's builders. You will lead cross-organizational programs from concept to launch, working with engineering, product, and security teams to deliver capabilities that thousands of teams depend on. You will build alignment across senior leaders, translate ambiguity into structure, and drive programs that operate at Amazon's full scale.

Key job responsibilities
Define and drive the program strategy for enterprise account governance across Amazon, translating ambiguity into clear roadmaps that teams can execute against.

Own cross-organizational programs end-to-end, from requirements through delivery, working with engineering, product, and security teams to ship governance capabilities that thousands of builders depend on.

Build alignment across senior leaders and stakeholders on how account classification, access policies, and guardrails should evolve as Amazon scales.

Identify gaps in how accounts are described, organized, and governed today. Propose and drive programs that close those gaps while keeping operational burden low for service owners and developers.

Establish mechanisms for tracking program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use data to inform prioritization and communicate progress to leadership.

Develop trusted partnerships with technical and non-technical teams across Amazon's businesses, ensuring governance programs reflect the needs of diverse builders operating at different risk profiles.

Evaluate complex technical and business requirements, surface tradeoffs and risks early, and drive decisions that balance governance rigor with builder velocity.

A day in the life
This role is inherently cross-functional and requires a strong ability to think big and influence others as you will work closely with teams across engineering, operations, finance, and security. title: Sr Program Manager, AI & Data Integration, Global Corporate Communications
description:
Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

description:

Summary

We are looking for a disciplined and detail-oriented QA Support Specialist to join our team. This is a straightforward, execution-focused manual testing role; it is not an automation-heavy or complex QA engineering position.

Your primary objective is the high-volume, repeatable validation of checkout flows to identify functional discrepancies between different site environments (specifically comparing two sides of an A/B test distinguishable by URL parameters). You will ensure that every step of the customer journey—from landing page to successful checkout—is seamless and error-free across all devices.

What you’ll be doing:

  • A/B Test Comparison: Ensure functionality matches perfectly between two sides of an A/B test by methodically comparing behaviors across different URL parameters.
  • Execution of Predefined Flows: Follow strict testing checklists to validate "happy paths" (e.g., adding products to cart, applying Gift With Purchase (GWP) items, and completing checkouts).
  • High-Volume Repetition: Run the same flows repeatedly across various environments with unwavering consistency and accuracy.
  • Environmental Comparison: Methodically compare behavior between different URLs/environments and flag even the slightest functional discrepancies.
  • Issue Identification & Reporting: Surface checkout blockers and functional inconsistencies.
  • Console Error Reporting: Identify and capture console errors.
    • Note: This requires identification and clear reporting, not deep technical debugging.
  • Cross-Platform Validation: Perform manual testing across Desktop (Chrome) and Mobile (Android-Chrome/iOS-Safari).
  • Documentation: Log issues with clear reproduction steps, screenshots/videos, and severity levels.
  • Logging: Maintain daily testing logs and summary reports to provide visibility into site health.

Typical Work Flow Example

  1. Navigate to a specific e-commerce site.
  2. Add a product to the cart and apply a GWP item.
  3. Proceed through the checkout funnel.
  4. Compare: Note any differences in UI or functionality between the standard site and the Nostra path.
  5. Report: Capture any blockers or console errors found during the process and log them immediately.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Experience: 1–3 years of relevant experience in manual QA or web testing.
  • Execution-Minded: This role is built for someone who thrives on process and volume; you must be comfortable performing repetitive tasks with a high degree of precision.
  • Technical Requirement: Ability to use Browser DevTools to spot and record console errors (deep code analysis is not required).
  • E-Commerce Familiarity: Understanding of standard e-commerce flows (Cart, GWP, Checkout, and Payment Gateways).
  • Communication: Strong written English skills to ensure bug reports are clear and easily understood by the development team.

What Success Looks Like

  • Early Detection: You catch functional discrepancies and checkout blockers before they impact the broader user base.
  • Precision Reporting: Your bug reports are clear, reproducible, and require no back-and-forth for clarification.
  • Reliability: You can execute daily testing checklists and volume targets with minimal oversight while maintaining total accuracy.

Benefits and Perks:

At eFlex, we're not just a workplace – we're a community of playmakers, committed to fostering growth, learning, and personal connections. Here's what's in store for you:

  • Living Our Values: We don't just talk the talk; we walk the walk. From learning and personal growth to caring deeply about our team and clients, our values are the compass guiding our vibrant workplace.
  • Competitive Compensation: Your hard work deserves recognition. Enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package, including comprehensive HMO coverage and optical reimbursements.
  • Flexible Work Options: Work your way! If you're outside Baguio City, embrace a permanent work-from-home setup. For those within Baguio, our hybrid work model offers the best of both worlds.
  • Wellness Matters: Recharge and refresh! Our flexible vacation and sick leaves empower you to prioritize your well-being, ensuring a healthy work-life balance.
  • Pathways to Success: Your journey with us is brimming with growth opportunities. We're dedicated to nurturing your career and supporting your rise through the ranks.

Ready to embark on an enriching journey? Join the eFlex family and experience a workplace that values your individuality and success. Let's thrive together!

title: AI Architect, Partner Engineering
description:
As an AI Architect leading the Agent Factory, you are the technical and strategic "tip of the spear" for Google Cloud’s AI ecosystem. Your mission is to operationalize and run high-velocity, immersive Agent Factory workshops that establish Gemini Enterprise as the undisputed platform of choice for our global partner network of 500+ strategic ISVs.

This is a highly hybrid, high-execution role requiring the deep implementation of a Senior Software Engineer, the agile facilitation skills of a technical sprint lead, and the commercial acumen of a Business Strategist. You will not just draw high-level system diagrams on a whiteboard; you will code alongside partners—guiding high-growth disruptors through a compressed, high-intensity lifecycle that moves them from an abstract concept to a functional, production-ready Multi-Agent System in a single day.

Beyond technical delivery, you will define what a "consumer-grade" enterprise AI experience looks like, translating deeply technical capabilities into quantifiable business value during rapid-prototyping cycles. Your work within these workshops will directly accelerate partner deployment velocity, shape the internal Google AI product roadmap, and drive ecosystem growth by proving the multi-product ROI of the Google Data and AI Cloud.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Execute Agent Factory Workshops: Own, facilitate, and scale the technical delivery of high-intensity Agent Factory workshops, successfully guiding strategic ISV partners (e.g., Salesforce, Adobe) from a blank slate to a functional, production-grade Multi-Agent System (MAS) in a single day.
  • Driect Co-Building: Take intiative and write code alongside partner engineering teams during live sprints to implement advanced reasoning architectures, model steering, and autonomous workflows using Gemini Enterprise.
  • Real-Time Engineering Unblocking: Resolve critical, time-sensitive hurdles in Identity Orchestration (OAuth/OIDC), Data Gravity (BigQuery Zero-Copy/AlloyDB AI), and enterprise security hardening (VPC-SC) on the fly to ensure live workshop prototypes achieve production-grade status.
  • Executive Technical Advisory: Advise partner CTOs and CPOs mid- and post-workshop on the long-term scalability of their agentic architectures and the quantifiable business ROI of transitioning to automated workflows.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
  • Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Security and Identity Mastery: Direct experience resolving complex integration hurdles in Identity Orchestration (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML) and cross-tenant security hardening (VPC-SC, IAM) within multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Agentic and LLM System Familiarity: Experience implementing LLM patterns, including Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), reasoning frameworks (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, ReAct), prompt engineering, or advanced model steering.
  • Direct Engineering and GenAI Execution: Software engineer experienced in delivering production-grade code and rapid prototypes on tight timelines.
  • Data Cloud Proficiency: Deep architectural knowledge of production-grade RAG, Vector Databases (ScaNN/HNSW), and high-scale data interoperability (BigQuery Zero-Copy, AlloyDB AI) to stand up robust enterprise agents rapidly.

title: Software Engineer, Firmware
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
  • Develop embedded firmware, bare metal tests and low-level debug tools for pre and post-silicon validation of SoCs. Exercise these capabilities on emulation, simulation and silicon platforms.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Machine Learning, Maps
description:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

As an Engineering Manager, you will oversee a team handling complex technical challenges in extracting vital information like speed limits and road signs from massive datasets. Your team leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Computer Vision techniques to directly impact the safety and reliability of mapping and in-car systems used by millions worldwide. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of ML, geospatial data, and the automotive industry, contributing to systems that have real-world impact on how people navigate.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Lead a team of software engineers designing and deploying machine learning models to extract map features and attributes.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and performance coaching to technical leads and engineers on the team.
  • Review systems designs and product development code to solve complex problems and ensure engineering best practices.

  • 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.
  • 5 years of experience in a people management or technical leadership role.
  • Experience building and deploying Machine Learning models.
  • Experience with Generative AI.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 7 years of experience deploying Machine Learning models in production environments.

  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems.
  • Ability to lead complex technical projects and collaborate with different stakeholders.

title: Sr. Sales Specialist, AI/ML, AUTO & MFG,  Auto & Mfg

You will earn trust with Line of Business, Data Science, and IT personas. You will understand detailed business drivers in your forecast and intentionally work the best opportunities that maximize your ability to hit revenue goals.


You will maintain an in-depth knowledge of AWS's Generative AI and ML services and relevant cross-functional areas to build strong relationships with customers. By driving the adoption of cutting-edge Generative AI and ML technologies, you will play a pivotal role in propelling AWS's revenue growth while helping customers stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving technological landscape. You exercise learn & be curious to articulate AWS’ Generative AI and ML strategy and the services we offer to accelerate these workloads. You conduct compelling executive conversations on the transformational possibilities of Generative AI and ML, while also being capable of helping our customers navigate which services to evaluate for their use-cases. You can describe the “why” and “what” of Generative AI and ML use case and technical solutions at a 200-level, with the detailed “how” being provided by solution architects.

Key job responsibilities
• Accelerate customer adoption by defining and implementing tech domain specific GTM strategies within your assigned accounts and technology domain. Your strategies will leverage AWS Sales and our partner ecosystem.
• Ideate with Line of Business and C-suite leaders, building trust with your deep technical expertise, and following through to help solve their most compelling business problems.
• Act as the front line within your accounts for all specialist customer engagement in your tech domain.
• Create & articulate compelling value propositions that address specific needs of your customers.
• Build and innovate: Co-Develop GTM motions on new product launches and work with product teams on the creation of innovative new services.
• Partner with the world’s biggest system integrators to deliver on customer projects.
• Spearhead market expansion by pinpointing new customer segments and Generative AI and ML use cases
• Collaborate cross-functionally to continuously strengthen AWS's Generative AI and ML value proposition
• Gather voice-of-customer insights to inform product roadmaps and enhance the customer experience
• Drive conversations to build credibility and earn trust with the account teams and customers.
• Drive sales efforts spanning multiple lines of business with decision-making authority and budget ownership.
• Engage systems integrators and closely collaborate with AWS partners to deliver maximum customer value
• Develop and deliver compelling ROI to drive adoption of AWS Generative AI and ML solutions


A day in the life
You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. title: Technical Solutions Engineer, Data
description:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

Our Technical Solutions Engineers own our large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to our other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.

In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Your team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for customers’ issues.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €74000 - €75500 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Manage customer issues through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
  • Understand Google's product technology and architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, determining the root cause for customer reported issues, and building tools for faster diagnosis.
  • Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
  • Advocate for customer needs with cross-functional teams, including product and engineering teams to find ways to improve the product and drive quality production.
  • Work as part of a team of engineers/consultants that globally ensure 24-hour customer support, including a need to sometimes work non-standard work hours or shifts.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience reading or debugging code (e.g., in one or more of the following: Java, C, C++, Python, Shell, .NET, Perl, JavaScript).
  • 5 years of experience in technical support, professional services, software development, or product operations management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience administering and querying data in distributed, columnar or analytic oriented databases or distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Experience with open source distributed storage and processing utilities in the Apache Hadoop family or workflow orchestration products.
  • Experience in data analytics, warehousing, ETL development, data science or other Big Data applications.
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL database administration, Google App Engine, open source software communities, Cloud networking solutions, or distributed computing technology.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Routing, VPNs, VLANs, Peering, Load Balancing, etc.), system/network administrator level knowledge of Linux/Unix or operating systems.

title: Same Day Program Excellence Lead, EU STEP
description:
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. Same Day is where that promise moves fastest. It is the speed frontier of Amazon delivery: customers order and receive their items within hours, on the same day, through a purpose-built network of Same Day sites and last mile operations. It is one of the fastest-growing parts of the business, with EU volumes set to grow by nearly 40% between 2026 and 2029. Delivering that growth depends on how well we plan, experiment, and scale, and Same Day Program Excellence sits at the center of it: turning data from across the network into the insights, mechanisms, and program governance that ensure the planning teams scale at pace with the business, so operations and capacity teams can build capacity, control cost, and delight customers with unmatched speed over the next five years.

The goal of Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is to build a world class last mile operation, exceeding the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible.

We are now looking to hire a passionate, dynamic, analytical, innovative, hands-on and customer-obsessed candidate to drive program excellence for the EU Same Day network. The Same Day Program Excellence lead (Analyst III) acts as the owner of the initiatives that sharpen how we plan and deliver, from data visualization to speed-and-cost trade-offs to experiments that scale the business. They transform ambiguity into a structured plan, engage with the required teams to drive and deliver, and form a business partnership with senior leaders and stakeholders across Same Day business, DEX, Operations, and capacity planning teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Program-manage the portfolio of new initiatives that improve data visualization, speed-and-cost trade-offs, and experiments to scale how we plan and deliver Same Day across EU. Understand in depth how we plan, what the OP2 goals are, and what is required to deliver them.
- Connect data from different sources and transform it into the inputs and signals the planning team relies on to make decisions.
- Define metrics, develop program management mechanisms, and invent and simplify processes to drive decision-making in complex, fast-moving situations.
- Communicate continuously with senior leaders and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders, transforming ambiguity into structured plans and engaging the required teams to deliver.
- Anticipate risks across initiatives and drive mitigation before they impact plans, cost, or customer speed.
- Own program management governance across Same Day business, DEX, Operations, and capacity planning teams, ensuring continuous improvement and adherence to lean philosophy at scale.

A day in the life
A day in the life In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Product, DEX, Finance, and more. You will use your analytical prowess to connect data across sources, identify opportunities for operational improvements, implement scalable systems, and drive automation to enhance efficiency, with a particular focus on the tools and decision frameworks that scale how we plan Same Day. Whether you are program-managing new initiatives, driving alignment with senior leaders, or running experiments to scale the business, your impact will be visible, ongoing, and contribute directly to our commitment to being the most customer-centric company on earth.

In order to be successful in this position, you need to be comfortable interfacing with senior stakeholders as well as driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. You will anticipate risks, drive mitigation, and hold strong program governance across a complex set of partners. Keeping an open mind, alongside drive and ambition, will help you remain innovative in our culture. This will be an exciting opportunity for you to possess a high level of autonomy and drive real operational improvements, while managing a variety of job responsibilities.

Summary

  • Ensure all necessary documentation has been completed; verify type of appointment needed, whether vision or medical; ensure a referral/authorization is obtained as needed.

  • Monitor and track all referral statuses using the scheduling resources to ensure timely scheduling and completion.

title: Business Analyst / Business Consultant-B2B Commerce
description:
Position Summary
SkillNet Solutions is hiring a Business Analyst / Business Consultant to lead discovery and requirements definition for complex B2B ordering and commerce implementations. This role sits at the center of our client engagements — running discovery workshops directly with client stakeholders, translating business needs into functional requirements, and partnering closely with technical delivery teams through build and deployment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with B2B commerce platforms and a strong grasp of the ordering complexity found in made-to-order, engineered-to-order, industrial manufacturing, wholesale distribution, and life sciences environments.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead client-facing discovery workshops to elicit, challenge, and validate B2B commerce and ordering requirements across sales, operations, and IT stakeholders.
  • Translate complex B2B ordering scenarios — configured products, contract pricing, quote-to-order workflows, approval hierarchies, and account-based catalogs — into clear, structured functional requirements.
  • Partner directly with technical architects and delivery teams to ensure requirements are implementable, and remain engaged through design, build, and testing to resolve ambiguity as it surfaces.
  • Produce discovery deliverables including current-state/future-state process maps, functional requirements documents, user stories, and gap/fit analyses against the target platform.
  • Advise clients on B2B commerce best practices specific to their industry — made-to-order and engineered-to-order configuration logic, industrial distribution ordering patterns, wholesale account structures, or life sciences compliance and ordering constraints.
  • Support solution scoping and estimation during presales, including SOW input and workshop planning for prospective engagements.
  • Identify downstream risks or scope gaps early and escalate proactively to engagement leadership.
Required Experience
  • 5+ years as a Business Analyst or Business Consultant on B2B commerce or B2B ordering platform implementations.
  • Direct, hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms: Spryker, Shopify (Plus/B2B), SAP Commerce Cloud, Kibo, or a comparable enterprise B2B commerce platform.
  • Demonstrated experience leading client discovery workshops independently, including agenda design, stakeholder facilitation, and synthesis of findings into requirements.
  • Proven track record developing functional requirements in close, ongoing collaboration with a technical delivery team — not requirements handed off and forgotten.
  • Domain exposure to at least one of: made-to-order or engineered-to-order manufacturing, industrial manufacturing/distribution, wholesale, or life sciences commerce.
  • Strong working knowledge of B2B commerce constructs: complex pricing and contracts, punchout/procurement integration, account hierarchies, approval workflows, and configure-price-quote (CPQ) concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate credibly in front of client VP- and director-level stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience across more than one of the named platforms (Spryker, Shopify, SAP Commerce, Kibo).
  • Prior consulting or systems-integrator experience, versus in-house/brand-side only.
  • Familiarity with ERP integration points relevant to B2B ordering (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar).
  • Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies and backlog/user story management tooling (Jira, Azure DevOps).
  • Prior experience supporting presales activities — discovery-stage scoping, SOW input, or solution estimation.
Engagement Details
  • Reports into SkillNet's Client Engagement organization (Strategic Consulting / Global Presales).
  • Client-facing role with travel as required by active engagements.
  • Immediate start — candidate should be available to begin an active client discovery engagement with minimal ramp time.

description:
