We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Service Technician
description:
EnerSys is the global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. With sales and service locations throughout the world, and over 100 years of battery experience, EnerSys is the power/full solution for stored DC power products.

This position will be focusing primarily on our Energy Systems line of business, which include telecommunications, IT, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), utilities and switchgear, security, emergency lighting and general electronics. Some of the reserve power brands include PowerSafe,DataSafe, and Genesis. Our extensive product range serves a variety of reserve power applications and consistently delivers the most effective, powerful and reliable batteries available.

Learn More About Energy Systems

Role Overview

The primary function of the role is warehouse-based diagnosis and repair of industrial batteries, chargers and associated equipment for EnerSys Industrial Mobility Solutions in Queensland. The second function is warehouse stock management and control, including the receipt, storage, maintenance, preparation and dispatch of batteries, chargers and parts. The third function is to provide occasional field-service support when operationally required, working within applicable licences, training and competence.

Main Responsibilities

Warehouse-based diagnosis and repair

  • Inspect, test and diagnose batteries, chargers and related equipment using approved fault-finding methods and diagnostic tools.
  • Perform authorised repairs, battery builds, component replacement and corrective maintenance in line with technical procedures.
  • Verify repairs through functional, charging and safety testing before release.
  • Identify warranty or non-conforming products and escalate findings as required.

Warehouse stock management and control

  • Receive, inspect and record incoming stock, reporting discrepancies or damage.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records, stock locations, transfers and adjustments within the ERP system.
  • Conduct cycle counts and stocktakes, investigating variances as required.
  • Store batteries, chargers, parts and dangerous goods in accordance with approved requirements.
  • Manage stock rotation and quarantine damaged or non-conforming items.

Occasional field service support

  • Assist with installations, preventive maintenance, breakdown repairs and equipment replacements at customer sites.
  • Diagnose, repair, install and commission equipment within authorised competencies.
  • Maintain accurate service records, communicate progress and obtain customer sign-off on completed work.
  • Manage tools, parts and equipment required for field activities.

Order preparation, packing and dispatch

  • Pick, prepare, test and label products in accordance with customer orders and work orders.
  • Pack and secure equipment to meet transport, dangerous goods and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate freight and dispatch activities and ensure all documentation is completed accurately.
  • Escalate shortages, delays, damage or other issues affecting customer deliveries.

Administration, facilities and equipment

  • Review work requests, confirm scope, priorities and completion requirements.
  • Accurately record labour, parts, stock movements, serial numbers and test results in company systems.
  • Maintain warehouse housekeeping, safe storage practices and operational work areas.
  • Complete inspections of forklifts, lifting equipment, tools and test instruments, reporting defects and removing unsafe equipment from service where required.

Ideal Candidate

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current Australian driver's licence and willingness to undertake occasional customer-site and regional travel.
  • Current High Risk Work Licence - Forklift (LF).
  • Demonstrated experience in warehousing, inventory control, technical service, maintenance or repair of industrial electrical, battery, material-handling, automotive or similar equipment.
  • Practical experience receiving, locating, picking, packing, dispatching and reconciling stock using an inventory, warehouse or ERP system.
  • Strong electrical and mechanical aptitude, including safe use of hand tools, power tools and electrical test instruments within competency.
  • Practical fault-finding capability and the ability to interpret technical instructions, wiring information and service documentation.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, numeracy and accurate digital record keeping.
  • Ability to plan work, manage competing warehouse priorities and work independently while remaining connected to the broader team.
  • Ability to safely perform the inherent physical requirements of the role using prescribed controls and mechanical aids.
  • Good skills in Problem solving.
  • Ability to work as part of a team, with or without supervision.

Preferred:

  • Relevant electrical, automotive electrical, mechanical, electro-mechanical or industrial trade qualification.
  • Experience with motive-power lead-acid or lithium-ion batteries, industrial chargers and battery monitoring systems.
  • Experience with cycle counting, stocktakes, serialised inventory, non-conforming stock and dangerous-goods storage.
  • Queensland electrical work licence or other relevant licence/authorisation.
  • White Card, First Aid, Working at Heights, EWP or dangerous-goods awareness training.
  • Experience using mobile field-service, asset-management or ERP systems.

title: Program Manager-Control Tower- Central Operations, Control Tower
description:
ATS Control Tower
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.

ATS Control Tower Overview
CT is the central control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon's European Transportation Middle Mile network, supporting both domestic and inter-country transportation movements for European geographies. Control Tower Team is the central owner to manage the sort center capacities in ATROPS and operates with a vision to provide uninterrupted sort center flows by managing the virtual capacities, tracking inbound flows and reacting to network disruptions that impact the Sort Center Flow. CT team plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's European transportation network and thereby has direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve customers on time.

Purview of a Program Manager
As a program manager in the supply chain management department with reporting function, your role encompasses strategic planning, project management, and process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing supply chain operations in alignment with organizational objectives, while also monitoring performance metrics and analyzing data to drive continuous improvement. Mitigating risks, ensuring compliance, and fostering cross-functional collaboration are paramount, as is providing leadership and direction to the supply chain team to maintain a high-performance culture focused on efficiency and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
- On-going generation and creation of reporting.
- Analyzing data to outline any reasons for under/over performance and take actions to improve performance.
- Support the delivery of productivity targets for all KPI's
- Ensure accurate recording and reporting of metrics.
- Performing updates and acting as an SME on workflow tools.
- Work closely with leadership to identify “hot spots” and take appropriate actions to minimize any impacts.
- Communicate and interact effectively with operations and support functions to provide internal customers with information/data needs in a timely manner.
- Evaluate and implement opportunities for improving workflow processes and automation of processes. (Using Excel VBA or in any other tool)
- Raise awareness to any areas for development or recognition.
- Maintain accurate local workforce management data.

A day in the life
Typically begins the day by reviewing and analyzing data to track key performance indicators and identify trends. They collaborate with various departments to gather information and ensure accurate reporting, while also preparing and presenting reports to stakeholders to inform decision-making processes. Additionally, they may oversee the development and implementation of reporting systems and processes to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

title: Genopslag - Provst for Jammerbugt Provsti, sognepræst i Midt-Hanherred Pastorat, Aalborg Stift
description:
Stillingen som tjenestemandsansat provst for Jammerbugt Provsti og sognepræst i Midt-Hanherred Pastorat, Aalborg Stift er ledig til besættelse den 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Den administrative/ledelsesmæssige del af stillingen udgør 75 %. Ansættelsesproceduren foregår efter reglerne i 14b i bekendtgørelse om lov om ansættelser i stillinger i folkekirken m.v. (LBK nr. 864 af 25/6/2013)

Stillingen er klassificeret i lønramme 37 jf. aftalen af 13. maj 2008 om klassificering af provstestillinger i folkekirken.

Ud over selve lønnen ydes provstetillæg I på 32.200 med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 årligt for en fuldtidsstilling.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Præstegårdsvej 4, Skovsgaard, 9460 Brovst.

Boligbidraget for tjenesteboligen excl. udgifter til el, vand og varme udgør på nuværende tidspunkt kr. 3.829,35.

Det forudsættes, at ansøgere har kørekort til almindelig bil (B) og er villig til at bruge egen bil i jobbet.

På Aalborg Stifts hjemmeside: Ledige præstestillinger | kan du læse embedsbeskrivelsen fra provstiudvalget og menighedsrådet. Her kan du læse om provstiet og sognet og om, hvilke tanker, provstiudvalg og menighedsrådet gør sig om det ledige embede.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om sognene og deres kirkeliv m.v., anbefaler vi at du orienterer dig på sognenes hjemmeside: Kirke & Sogn - Fælles forside.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Både mænd og kvinder opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Du kan kontakte biskoppens sekretær for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskop Thomas Reinholdt Rasmussen, inden det orienteringsmøde.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kongen, men skal sendes til biskoppen over Aalborg Stift pr. mail til: KMAAL-ANSOEGNING@KM.DK og ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

title: Sr, Manager, UX/Design, Talent Acquisition-Tech
description:
Hiring is one of the most consequential decisions a person makes or receives, and the tools that power it are becoming genuinely agentic. We are seeking a Senior Manager of UX to lead the design and research organization behind our hiring portfolio at exactly this inflection point.

This is a rare leadership role. The products your team shapes increasingly act on behalf of the people who use them: drafting job descriptions, surfacing candidates, generating assessments, flagging risks, and moving work forward. The underlying systems are probabilistic. The experiences your team designs must not be. Your core challenge is building and leading a team that can translate AI systems operating on confidence, inference, and ranked signals into interactions that feel trustworthy, purposeful, and in control — where users understand what the system did, why, and what happens next.

You are a people leader with dual accountability: you own experience strategy across the full hiring portfolio, and you build the team, culture, and craft bar that make world-class work repeatable — not dependent on any one person. You partner as a peer with Principal Engineers, senior PMs, and Research and Product leaders from strategy through launch. You influence product direction and long-term business strategy, and you set the quality bar by developing the people and mechanisms that hold it.


Key job responsibilities
**Lead and grow the UX organization.** Build, structure, and develop a high-performing team of designers and researchers. Own hiring, org design, headcount planning, and resourcing across the portfolio. Set clear performance expectations, give direct and developmental feedback, manage performance, and actively drive career growth - including contributions to the promotion process. Recruit and raise the bar on talent.

**Own experience vision and strategy across the hiring portfolio.** Set the north star for Recruiter Hub, Hiring Hub, and Candidate Hub as a coherent, connected system - not three products. Define how users move between surfaces, how context transfers, and how the portfolio adds up to more than its parts. Lead this vision through your team rather than solely through your own hands.

**Define the agentic interaction model for hiring - through your team.** Own the strategy for experiences where AI acts on behalf of recruiters and hiring managers: delegation surfaces, approval flows, correction mechanisms, confidence transparency, and escalation paths. Establish the principles for when the system should act, when it should ask, and what trust looks like when it gets something wrong - and hold the team accountable to them.

**Establish scalable mechanisms and cross-product standards.** Create the interaction models, experience principles, design patterns, and measurement systems that govern AI-assisted hiring surfaces across the portfolio (e.g., UX/CX benchmarking, customer-frustration tracking, ongoing experience measurement). Ensure the system speaks one language at the human-AI boundary and that quality scales across partner teams rather than depending on heroics.

**Set and hold the design excellence bar.** Act as creative director for quality across the portfolio. Partner with and develop design and research leaders to raise the floor on visual craft, interaction quality, research rigor, and storytelling. Establish the review mechanisms and standards that make the bar visible and durable.

**Influence product and business direction.** Work with senior leadership to identify where design and research unlock product strategy, not just execute it. Bring recruiter, hiring manager, and candidate insight into roadmap decisions before requirements are written. Contribute to OP1/OP2 and 3-Year Plan (3YP) efforts, and be a named voice in strategic tradeoffs across major products and product suites.

**Own strategic communications.** Own research narratives, experience strategy documents, executive readouts, and quarterly status updates within and outside the organization. Make design and research rationale legible to non-designers and make the business case for quality to executive leadership.

**Drive rigor and delivery through the team.** Ensure the team uses research, behavioral data, and usability findings to diagnose the real problem before proposing solutions, and that specifications function as behavior contracts partners can build against. Ensure engineering partnership through delivery and close the gap between intent and reality.


A day in the life
You start your morning in a portfolio review - but you're not critiquing pixels, you're developing judgment. A designer walks through the AI-generated candidate summary feature; you name the three places where the model's uncertainty isn't surfaced and coach the team on why that matters for trust, so they catch it themselves next time. By mid-morning you're in a product strategy session with the PM and Principal Engineer on the Candidate Hub, where a roadmap capability threatens to fragment the experience into a fourth surface - you reframe the conversation and align leadership on the connected-system alternative.

In the afternoon you're working org problems: a hiring loop for a senior researcher, a career-development conversation with a design lead who's ready to grow, and a resourcing tradeoff across two teams competing for the same headcount. You end the day reviewing your team's craft bar - not to approve work, but to make sure the standard is visible, shared, and getting higher without you in the room.


About the team
Talent Solutions Product Design & Research designs the products that power how Amazon hires: the tools recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates use across the full hiring journey. We own the end-to-end experience across the Recruiter Hub, Hiring Hub, and Candidate Hub, and we are at the leading edge of what it means to put AI into consequential, human-centered workflows.

We are building agentic products in a domain where trust is not optional. Our AI systems recommend, rank, predict, and increasingly act. Our design work determines whether people trust those systems enough to rely on them, understand them enough to correct them, and feel good enough about the experience to advocate for it. We are designers, researchers, and strategists who work backward from the people we serve, hold an unusually high bar for craft, and believe that the experience of being hired - or of hiring someone - matters.

title: Sr. Product Manager, AWS Identity, AWS Directory Service
description:

AWS Directory Service enables organizations to leverage their existing AD investments, skills, and applications while creating new directories, extending existing AD, or establishing secure connections between different AD environments. Our services allow seamless authentication with AWS resources like Amazon EC2 instances and managed services like RDS and FSx.

title: Digital Platforms & Security Lead
description:
Salary: Wellbeing benefits + Growth + Flexible working

About the role

We’re working with a Taupō-based organisation looking for an experienced Digital Platforms & Security Lead who can combine strong technical judgement with people leadership and big-picture thinking.

This is a hands-on leadership role spanning technology platforms, operational cybersecurity, resilience, technical risk and key supplier relationships. You’ll lead specialist capability across platforms, workplace technology and cybersecurity, setting priorities, developing your people and providing technical direction and escalation support.

A key part of the opportunity is translating broader digital strategy into a practical longer-term technical roadmap. You’ll help drive the phased transition toward greater use of cloud, SaaS and Zero Trust technologies, while reducing reliance on legacy on-premises infrastructure.

Alongside this change, the fundamentals still matter. You’ll help ensure the technology environment remains secure, reliable and resilient, with strong operational security controls, incident response and disaster recovery capability aligned with wider business continuity requirements.

You’ll also work across the organisation, building relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders and helping connect business needs with technology priorities, risk and improvement opportunities.

The role balances day-to-day operational responsibility with ongoing modernisation and improvement, keeping critical technology running while continuing to look at how platforms, processes and ways of working can evolve.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading and developing specialist capability across platforms, workplace technology and cybersecurity

  • Translating broader digital strategy into practical technical priorities and a longer-term roadmap

  • Driving the phased transition toward cloud, SaaS and Zero Trust technologies

  • Reducing reliance on legacy on-premises infrastructure while maintaining reliable operational delivery

  • Providing technical leadership across infrastructure, platforms and security

  • Managing cybersecurity controls, operational compliance and incident response, while surfacing key technical risks

  • Strengthening disaster recovery and system resilience in support of wider business continuity objectives

  • Acting as an escalation point for complex platform and security issues

  • Managing key technology suppliers, service performance and improvement activity

  • Identifying opportunities to improve operational delivery through automation, AI and other technologies

  • Building strong relationships across the organisation and supporting effective technology change

What we’re looking for

We’re interested in experienced technology leaders who can operate comfortably across both the detail and the bigger picture.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Substantial experience across cybersecurity or IT operations, with demonstrated team leadership or supervisory experience

  • Strong understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards and IT operations best practice, including ISO 27001

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, security tools and IT service management processes

  • Strong understanding of incident management, change control and vulnerability management

  • Experience working with Agile and DevOps practices

  • Strong people leadership, with the ability to guide, coach and develop technical specialists

  • The ability to turn technology direction into practical priorities, roadmaps and delivery

  • Experience managing technology suppliers or external service partners

  • Strong relationship-management and communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Sound judgement, strong problem-solving capability and the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • A continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to work constructively through change

  • A tertiary qualification in information technology or a related discipline

Relevant certifications across information security, ITIL 4, Check Point, Azure/AWS architecture, FinOps or DevOps would be advantageous.

What’s on offer?

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on technology leadership with genuine scope to influence how the technology environment develops over time.

You’ll also be joining an organisation that offers:

  • Flexible, family-friendly working

  • Wellbeing support and employee benefits

  • Career development and growth opportunities

  • A strong focus on supporting people to develop their strengths

Keen to learn more?

If you’re an experienced technology leader who enjoys leading people, improving how things work and helping move a technology environment forward, this is worth a conversation.

title: Legal Operations Assistant
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Operations and Administrative Support professional to join our legal team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys keeping processes running smoothly, and understands the importance of discretion, accuracy, and professionalism when handling sensitive legal and business information.

In this position, you will provide essential support to the General Counsel and legal operations team by coordinating legal matters, managing calendars and meetings, preparing and organizing legal documents, tracking invoices and payments, and maintaining accurate legal files. You will also collaborate with internal departments such as Finance, HR, Procurement, and IT, as well as outside counsel and vendors, to help ensure legal operations are efficient, compliant, and well-organized.

The successful candidate will bring Legal Secretary background, strong communication skills, sound judgment, excellent follow-through, and a proactive approach to supporting legal department priorities. This is a great opportunity for a dependable professional who enjoys administrative excellence, legal operations, and cross-functional collaboration.

Job Duties include but are not limited to the following:

I. Legal Operations Support

  • Assists with tracking legal matters, contracts, invoices, outside counsel information, and other legal department activities.
  • Prepare routine reports and status summaries for management.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, i.e., Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and other departments on legal-related administrative matters.
  • Arrange travel accommodations and logistics when required.
  • Track action items and follow up with responsible parties to ensure timely completion.
  • Maintain compliance and handle confidential or privileged information with discretion.
  • Follow company policies regarding privacy, records management, document retention and information security.
  • Escalate sensitive, unusual, or time-critical matter to the appropriate business partners or stakeholders.

II. Legal Administrative Support

  • Provide day-today administrative support to the General Counsel and operations staff.
  • Prepare, format, proofread, and organize legal documents, correspondence, reports and presentations.
  • Maintain calendars, schedule meetings, hearings, depositions and other legal appointments.
  • Assist with preparation of meeting agendas, material and follow-up items.
  • Handle routine correspondence and communications with internal departments, clients, vendors and outside counsel.

III. Legal Invoice Review and Payment Processing

  • Review invoices submitted by outside counsel and vendors for accuracy, completeness, billing compliance and adherence to applicable engagement letters and billing guidelines.
  • Prepare invoice review summaries and recommendations for attorney review, when appropriate.
  • Communicate with outside law firms and legal vendors regarding billing questions, discrepancies, supporting documents and payment status.
  • Prepare and submit internal payment requisition and other documentation necessary to process payments.
  • Track invoices through the review, approval, and payment process and follow-up as necessary to ensure timely payment.

V. Document and File Management

  • Maintain and organize electronic and physical legal files in accordance with company policies.
  • Assist with document naming, filing, indexing, scanning and retrieval.
  • Monitor deadlines and ensure required documents and information are properly submitted and stored.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive legal business information.

title: Licensed Clinical Program Manager
description:
Except in the case of an undue hardship, La Familia provides reasonable accommodations to persons with disabilities when the accommodations are necessary to enable the persons to perform the essential functions of the job. The Agency also provides reasonable accommodations when necessary based on religious needs. Individuals requiring workplace accommodations must discuss their needs with La Familia Human Resources. Individuals seeking accommodations for disabilities are typically required to provide medical documentation supporting the existence of a disability, the need for the accommodation, and what workplace modifications will enable the employee to perform the essential functions of the job.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We seek an enthusiastic and experienced Clinical Program Manager for our Adult Outpatient Programs. This position is responsible for ensuring high-quality, trauma-informed, culturally responsive behavioral health services while maintaining compliance with Medi-Cal, CalAIM, county contract requirements, and agency policies. Reporting directly to the Director of Adult Outpatient Programs, the operational base of this position will be in our office at 27206 Calaroga, Ste 107, Hayward, CA 94545, with this role being a hybrid remote schedule based on programmatic and organizational needs. This role will uphold and champion the agency’s mission, vision, and values and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive work culture.

The Clinical Program Manager oversees staff performance and training, clinical quality, program contracts, design, and operations, service delivery outcomes, documentation compliance, productivity standards, and program development initiatives. This position serves as a key liaison between frontline staff, agency leadership, county partners, and community stakeholders to ensure effective service delivery and positive client outcomes.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Program Supervision of Direct Service:

  • Maintains a clear record of all supervisees and adheres to all BBS requirements for supervision of associate staff.
  • In the absence of a Program Supervisor or Director, meet with the various Adult OP Teams to provide consultation on diagnosis and establish Medical Necessity, and complete Assessments as required by Medi-Cal Specialty Mental Health.
  • Supports staff with psychological or family functioning evaluations; coaches on appropriate diagnostic procedures; conducts clinical interviews with clients/families and other interested persons to develop information pertinent to either diagnosis or a family treatment plan.
  • Provides individualized training and support for client treatment, which may include: assessments, crisis interventions, treatment plans, psychotherapy, family counseling, individual rehabilitation, and case management, depending on the scope of the program for which services are offered.
  • Meets with Staff Therapists, Counselors and Case Managers, and other treatment team members for therapeutic interviews and case management as needed, including guiding the client/family in understanding his/her illness and contributing personal, social, and economic factors; assisting client/family in developing realistic plans; monitoring symptoms; advising client/family on community resources; and making referrals and other linkage arrangements as necessary.
  • Provide on-call clinical consultation and leadership support on a rotating or as-needed basis during weekends and holidays for urgent, high-risk client situations requiring management involvement.

Program Leadership and Standards:

  • Provide clinical leadership to all programs, including consultation, supervision, documentation review, and documentation completion as assigned by the Director.
  • Support the Director and Supervisory staff of Adult Programs in reporting, program design, county and funder meetings, and clinical and administrative tasks as necessary.
  • Actively network and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to enhance program services and agency objectives.
  • Lead and collaborate on special projects related to the success of Adult OPprograms.
  • Participate in the hiring of program staff: using network connections to identify appropriate entities for staff recruitment, developing and updating job descriptions and interview questions, and collaborating with other leadership staff on final selections and onboarding.

Training and Transition Leadership and Standards:

  • Coordinate and hold responsibility for onboarding and orientation of new staff and trainees (including credentialling, BBS supervisory agreements, and county system access points).
  • Provide information on program transfers to the Adult Outpatient Director and Supervisory leadership across all Adult OP programs, including contractual, fiscal, operational, and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with Adult Outpatient Director, Supervisory leadership across Adult OP programs, and Chief Clinical Officer (CCO) to regularly review, update, and codify procedures not already covered in program manuals (staff onboarding, intake processes, documentation, Officer of the Day protocols, data collection, tracking, and reporting).
  • Ensure consistent dissemination of updated policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements in collaboration with the Director of Adult OP and Chief Clinical Officer.
  • Support program transitions, implementation of new initiatives, and organizational change management.
  • Meet with the Adult Outpatient Director and CCO, as well as any other Supervisory Leadership or La Familia staff as needed for collaborative initiatives.
  • Support the Director and Supervisory staff of Adult Programs in all other clinical and administrative tasks as necessary as requested.

Staff Supervision:

  • Provide day-to-day supervision, guidance, and support to assigned staff.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, delegate tasks effectively, and monitor staff performance and accountability measures.
  • Foster a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment aligned with organizational values.
  • Conduct regular administrative supervision, team meetings, check-ins, and coaching sessions, and annual performance evaluations.
  • Address performance concerns promptly, documenting and escalating issues when necessary.
  • Support professional development by identifying training needs and opportunities for growth.
  • Provide leadership and clinical/ programmatic supervision to program staff across all Adult Outpatient program staff.
  • Provide leadership and clinical/ programmatic supervision to the Multicultural Psychotherapy Training Institute (MPTI) for assigned trainees.
  • Provide weekly group clinical/ programmatic supervision to assigned staff and MPTI trainees across all Adult programs.
  • Regular informal feedback (in addition to organizationally-determined formalized feedback processes) to ensure that all staff continue to develop professionally over time.
  • Provide leadership in collaboration with other leadership staff:
  • Review, maintain, update, and prepare to distribute Program Manual updates for each program and Staff Orientation materials in collaboration with the Director and CCO.
  • Establish and enforce expectations for professional ethical conduct.
  • Develop, edit, and implement training processes and materials for all staff in collaboration with the Director and CCO.
  • Support the development of graduate trainees assigned in collaboration with the MPTI Clinical Training Leader (CT), Director, and CCO.
  • Provide back-up administrative supervision on behalf of the Director and Clinical Supervisor.
  • Track performance expectations for programs and staff members, most notably hours of billable services, documentation standards, and quality clinical interventions in collaboration with the Director and CCO for assigned staff or MPTI trainees.
  • Collaborate to develop, maintain, and verify quality standards for the program in partnership with La Familia’s Quality Assurance Department and CCO.

Contract Management:

  • Review and understand the scope of work from contracts for programs across the Adult Outpatient Department, including: performance expectations, staffing levels, reporting, regulatory bodies, policy requirements, and program meetings.
  • Monitor contract deliverables, reporting deadlines, and performance measures.
  • Collaborate with the department Director, CCO, and La Familia Strategy and Development in identifying, pursuing, and fulfilling appropriate funding opportunities for the Department or Agency.
  • Participate in funder meetings and collaborative efforts, as needed by the Director and CCO, in collaboration with other department leadership.
  • Communicate effectively, proactively, and professionally with funder representatives and community partners at all levels.

Program & Coverage Responsibilities:

  • Hold strategic vision for smooth program operations during staffing changes or emergencies by providing coverage for essential duties when positions are vacant.
  • Temporarily fill in unstaffed roles until the position is filled.
  • Prioritize workload and allocate resources to maintain service delivery during staffing transitions including holding caseload or holding groups as needed and in collaboration with the Director of Adult OP.
  • Communicate staffing needs and operational impacts to leadership promptly.
  • Support cross-program collaboration to maximize service delivery.

Timekeeping & Attendance Responsibilities:

  • Complete assigned work on or before deadlines in accordance with directives, policies, standards, and prescribed procedures.
  • Ensure staff and/ or MPTI Trainees complies with established work schedules, attendance, and punctuality requirements.
  • Monitor and approve employee timecards, including daily clock-in/out, breaks, overtime, and leave for any assigned staff.
  • Ensure employees take required meal and rest breaks in compliance with labor laws and agency policy.
  • Submit approvals on time to support accurate payroll processing.
  • Investigate and resolve timesheet discrepancies in collaboration with the Director and escalate unresolved issues to HR/Payroll.
  • Enforce organizational policies, procedures, and compliance with applicable labor laws.

Other

  • Complete internal reports as requested by the Director, CCO, and executive and administrative staff members.
  • Lead and/or collaborate on special projects related to agency objectives, as requested by the Director and/ or CCO, where appropriate.
  • Attend training and participate in events relevant to key responsibilities.
  • Track and regularly report to the Director and CCO on key metrics for assigned program areas.
  • Lead and collaborate on special projects related to agency objectives as requested by the Director and CCO, where appropriate.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Leading the self:

  • Demonstrates ethics and integrity
  • Displays drive and purpose
  • Manages self and adapts to change
  • Exhibiting leadership stature
  • Practice self-awareness and continuous learning

Leading others:

  • Communicates effectively
  • Supports the professional development of staff
  • Builds and maintains relationships
  • Promotes effective teamwork
  • Responsive and accepts feedback
  • Responds timely to requests of supervisees and all staff

Leading the organization:

  • Manages change
  • Problem solves effectively
  • Navigates organizational dynamics
  • Develops and executes strategy
  • Managing politics and influencing others
  • Enhances organizational knowledge and skills

INCLUSION, RESPECT, AND COLLABORATION:

title: Front Office I - Bilingual in Spanish
location: Belmont Health Center - Los Angeles, CA 90026
description:
POSITION: Front Office I – SBHC Multi-Function

STATUS: Non-exempt; Full time

REPORTS TO: Clinic Manager

SUPERVISES: None

DEPARTMENT: Clinic Operations

OFFICIAL DUTY STATION: Belmont Health Center

SUMMARY:

Asian Pacific Health Care Venture, Inc. (APHCV) expects all Clinic Operations (CO) staff to be a part of the revenue cycle process that contributes to the optimization of capturing, management and collection of patient service revenue.

APHCV is in the business to serve patients; APHCV is committed to the provision of patient centric care at all levels, from the CO Telephone Operator, Front Office and Medical Interpreters (and beyond). This position will be a part of a multi-disciplinary care team that facilitates and provides culturally and linguistically sensitive services by assisting with patient flow activities to reduce patient wait time and to provide higher overall patient’s satisfaction.

Clinic Operation Department includes a centralized Call Center and Medical Record Unit. However, some of Call Center and Medical Record functions are assumed by Clinic Operations site specific staff. Hence, this position is responsible for various aspects of Clinic Operations functions: Front Office, Medical Record, Medical Interpreter and Telephone Operator. The position is expected to perform all duties with special emphasis on accuracy, efficiency and customer satisfaction.

APHCV expects all employees to participate in APHCV’s emergency response operations per our emergency policies and procedures.

APHCV requires all staff to comply with Standards of Conduct and Compliance Program related policies and procedures. Such compliance is part of this position’s performance evaluation.

APHCV is a tobacco-free organization.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Front Office
    1. Greet patients as this position is the face of the Health Center.
    2. Verify patient’s appointment in NextGen Enterprise Practice Management (EPM).
    3. Update and verify patient’s information/data contained in NextGen EPM.
    4. Check and correct any additional system alerts in NextGen EPM.
    5. Scan documents such as program applications, requirements, identifications (IDs) and insurance card into NextGen ICS.
    6. Check to make sure that Financial Screening, program enrollment and verification is complete at check in.
    7. Enroll/Renew patient program such as Family PACT, MHLA, CHDP, CDP, PE, Sliding Fee Discount Program (SFDP) or Self-Pay.
    8. Review and explain forms in the patient registration packet to patient at new patient registration and annual screening/review process for established patient.
    9. Verify or set up insurance in NextGen EPM.
    10. Collect any pervious balance and all co-pays that are outstanding or due during the visit.
    11. Place fee ticket with all appropriate documentation in identified provider bin.
    12. Maintain smooth patient flow through communication between patient, provider, Medical Assistant (MA) and other clinic support staff.
    13. Handle scheduling inquiries and make appropriate patient appointments.
    14. Provide assistance and information to patient when requested.
    15. Consistently complete patient check in and checkout in a timely manner.
    16. Review and provide patient with Patient Plan printed by provider team, appointment card and any other pertinent information attached to the patient medical record.
    17. Provide directions to patient on check in process at Dispensary for medications prescribed.
    18. Consistently provide marketing for health center through the solicitation of patient donations.
    19. Keep clinic and waiting area clean, organized and safe.
    20. Answer telephone calls promptly and courteously.
    21. Retrieve voice mail messages and return calls appropriately.
    22. Transfer telephone calls to other staff (e.g. nursing staff, outreach staff or etc. accordingly) appropriately.
    23. Make, cancel and re-schedule appointments as needed.
    24. Run eligibility for new patients with managed care Medi-Cal insurance prior to making new patient appointment and instructs patients accordingly based on their PCP assignment
    25. Task Triage Nurses and Referral Nurses accordingly.
    26. Ensure complete and accurate data entry during telephone patient registration process.
    27. Create and deactivate NextGen EPM alerts as needed.
    28. Utilize park, paging and voicemail systems to ensure proper routing of telephone calls.
    29. Provide general information about APHCV e.g. directions, scope of services, available programs and etc.
    30. Conduct patient recall via internal recall list and health plan member list.
    31. Consistently provide financial screening for all next day patient charts, during the course of the workday.
    32. Call all patients that need to provide additional financial information for their next day appointment.
    33. Call all patients if upon financial screening review patients’ medical home or Primary Care Provider (PCP) is not anchored with APHCV.
    34. Assist patient in the selection and changes of PCP at Health Centers and maintain up-to-date PCP assignment in NextGen EPM, and make a referral to Enrollment Unit if external PCP assignment change is necessary.
    35. Provide Health Center information by reviewing the Patient Guide at the new patient registration and at annual screening/review process for established patient.
    36. Ensure proper credit/payment is maintained on patient’s account (e.g. perform cashiering duties, posting charges, prints out receipt, etc.).
    37. Perform all opening and closing functions as required such as opening and closing of daily cash box, batching and posting encounters, counting and preparing daily deposit and all other necessary activities.
    38. Turn on and turn off television in patient waiting area at appropriate times.
    39. Maintain patient comment box i.e. supply of comment cards, retrieving comments periodically.
    40. Ensure infection control by wearing mask when exposure is known i.e. when patient or self is coughing consistently.
    41. Monitor and assure that clinic forms are replenished in a timely manner (e.g. patient intake forms, mammogram forms, etc.).
    42. Maintain an adequate paper supply in the photocopy machine.
    43. Shred unnecessary printed Patient Protected Health Information and fee tickets on daily basis.
    44. Attend and participate in clinic staff meetings and training: always come prepared with a notebook and a pen.
    45. Assist in data collection for CO performance measures.
    46. Forward patient’s concern and feedback to appropriate personnel within APHCV for resolution and optimization of clinic efficiency.
    47. Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisor(s).
  2. Medical Record Duties
    1. Ensures that all medical records are maintained appropriately; secure, complete and up to date at all times.
    2. Keeps patient medical records cabinets organized and secure at all times
    3. Ensures that all documentation contained in patient health record has appropriate label identifying the patient correctly.
    4. Immediately notifies Medical Record Unit Supervisor or Medical Record Lead if patient paper health record has incorrect patient information identified in it.
    5. Answers calls regarding patient medical record questions and requests
    6. Coordinate and respond to internal and external protected health information requests. Work with Medical Record Unit at LFHC, assures completion of release of medical records requests, including verifying identification of the patient/requester before handing the PHI to the patient/requester
    7. Facilitates patients with the request for patient protected health information release to other facilities and for the patient’s own use by coordinating with Medical Records Unit, LFHC.
    8. Transfers and maintains records electronically by scanning, importing, and indexing the consultation reports, et cetera
    9. Ensures the appropriateness of forms used in electronic health record.
    10. Coordinate and centralize the authorization form in requesting the consultation report from other providers/facilities to Medical Records Unit (LFHC)
    11. Update and document the receipt of consultation report in order management (EHR/NextGen)
    12. Check digital fax on daily basis
    13. End of day functions: ensures that all loose documents are reviewed and all forms are appropriately scanned and filed in correct document types in ICS/NextGen according to the ICS scanning guidelines. All forms scanned have patient label attached to clearly identify the correct patient.
  3. Medical Interpreter Duties:
    1. Provide intake and assist with financial screening and Health History intake for limited English proficient patients.
    2. Provide interpretation at various points of patient interaction to support clinic operations such as scheduled patient visits with providers.
    3. Call patients 2 days before their appointment to remind them of their appointment if language is not supported by Call Center.
    4. Provide either interpretation or instruction at classes for patients on various health topics.
    5. Contact patients in a timely manner in response to voicemails left by patients.
    6. Contact and follow up with patients who no-showed for their medical appointment(s) in accordance with the “No Show Follow Up” procedure. Document such patient contact in NextGen EPM or EHR.
    7. Work with CO and medical staff to facilitate efficient patient flow.
    8. Assist with data collection for day to day activity and clinic performance measures.
    9. Call patients per care team’s order for various purposes including follow up of patients with abnormal lab results. Document such calls made in EHR, according to procedure.
    10. Verify and schedule future appointments when necessary.
    11. Submit quality of care and productivity reports to Supervisor, if any.
    12. Request the in-person interpreter from health care plan and document such request in the patient chart (EPM, appointment detail box) and in the interpreter request tracking log (in the HUB)
    13. Translate clinic documents, outreach materials and health education materials in timely manner.
    14. Perform back translation to evaluate the accuracy of the translation.
    15. Type set or coordinates with other staff to type set the translated material.
    16. Attend a continuing education class for furthering and keeping abreast in the medical interpretation field.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:

  • Maintain professionalism and excellent customer service at all times with patients, caregivers, and other staff regardless of cultural, education, socio-economic and linguistic background.
  • Speak clearly, distinctly and professionally on telephone and face to face patient encounters.
  • Maintain high level attendance pattern to ensure department is accurately covered at all times.
  • Work as a team player and be willing to assist co-workers in other duties within his/her capabilities, to aid the clinic team in providing good efficient patient care.
  • Facilitate patient flow by working effectively and efficiently.
  • Work Saturdays and evening hours as scheduled.
  • Maintain open communication with other clinic staff.
  • Meet other performance expectations as conveyed by supervisor(s).

title: Membership Representative 1 - Opener
description:

Staff can progress to Membership Representative 2, Membership Representative 3 and further as positions become available. At each step, employees achieve milestones and acquire valuable career skillsets for their resumes, as well as increased compensation rates.

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit, charitable organization committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. The Membership Representative at the Eugene Family YMCA maintains a supportive, positive atmosphere that welcomes and respects all individuals. This position is a front-facing member service position stationed at one of our Welcome Centers (Don Stathos Campus and Tennis & Pickleball Center.) title: Program Manager, Speed EF, BR OPS
description:
We are seeking a results-driven Program Manager to lead delivery speed growth initiatives for External Fulfillment (EF). This role is responsible for developing and executing strategic plans that optimize delivery speed for third-party sellers while expanding seller participation and network density. The successful candidate will leverage data analytics, cross-functional collaboration, and supply chain knowledge to design scalable solutions that balance seller experience, customer delivery expectations, and operational efficiency. This position requires the ability to influence stakeholders across teams, translate data into actionable recommendations, and drive alignment among business, operations, and seller-facing organizations to deliver measurable improvements in external fulfillment performance.

This role offers the opportunity to directly impact delivery speed for millions of customers and thousands of sellers. You will responsible to monitoring programs that define sellers compete on delivery speed and how the marketplace grows in strategic segments. The position requires balancing medium-term planning with day-to-day execution, often navigating ambiguous situations where structured problem-solving and sound judgment are essential.

The ideal candidate brings both analytical rigor and operational pragmatism, recognizing that successful programs must be implementable and sustainable. You should be comfortable working with incomplete information, defining assumptions, and iterating based on data and business results. The ability to coordinate across teams with different priorities is critical, as success depends on building alignment among diverse stakeholder groups.

The role demands
someone who can operate at multiple levels, contributing to strategic planning while also diving deep into operational details to remove blockers and ensure execution. You should be comfortable switching between planning discussions with senior leaders and detailed analytical reviews with operations teams, owning the end-to-end delivery of your programs from concept through implementation and measurement.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the delivery speed roadmap for External Fulfillment (EF), connecting planned initiatives with the medium and long-term plan, monitoring network capabilities and operational mechanisms required to achieve competitive delivery speeds

• Drive data-driven analysis about EF speed performance and improvement opportunities, leveraging large-scale datasets to identify geographic gaps, seller capability constraints, and network design enhancements that enable faster delivery promises and improved customer experience

• Act as the bridge between business and operations teams, translating growth objectives into operational requirements and operational constraints into plan adjustments, ensuring alignment among all stakeholders

• Conduct trade-off analyses, evaluating speed improvements against cost implications, seller experience impacts, and operational complexity, presenting recommendations to leadership with clear ROI and risk assessments

• Monitor optimization strategies spanning seller on-boarding, order tracking, transportation network design, last-mile delivery and scalable speed improvements

• Support EF strategic planning processes, contributing to the definition of investment priorities, resource requirements, and success metrics aligned with business objectives

• Implement and maintain governance mechanisms for EF speed initiatives, including decision-making frameworks, escalation paths, and performance and results review cadences

In this role, you will be the bridge between business intent and system behavior — owning the logic layer that determines how charges are captured, how claims are constructed, and how payer rules are applied.

This is a high-impact role as you will impact every bill that goes out. You will transform a legacy way of working by injecting a savvy data and systems skill set, backed by Amazon's engineering resources, customer obsession culture, and a leadership team that believes financial accuracy is the foundation of a sustainable healthcare business.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with billing operations, finance, and clinical stakeholders to understand complex billing requirements and translate them into scalable, logical functional specifications that power the billing engine

- Define and maintain billing rules, payer-specific configurations, and charge logic that drive accurate claim generation

- Use data analysis to identify billing defects, revenue leakage patterns, and configuration gaps — prioritize work by financial impact, not squeaky-wheel urgency

- Build and maintain reporting and monitoring to validate system behavior and catch issues proactively. Maintain documentation of business rules, configuration decisions, and system dependencies

- Identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with systematic, rules-based automation — reducing human error and accelerating throughput

- Design scalable processes that accommodate new service lines, payer contracts, and business models without bespoke rework

- Work with engineering to ensure requirements are implementable, testable, and maintainable; participate in design discussions and QA validation

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Stores Security - HealthCare
description:
At Amazon Healthcare Security (HealthSec), we are on a mission to make healthcare secure and easy. We are developing a patient centric healthcare experience that is personal, transparent, and convenient. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex, cross organizational programs across our health portfolio.

As a Senior TPM, you are part of a global organization of security engineers, software developers, and technical program managers dedicated to continuously raising the security bar. We operate with an AI First mindset, leveraging generative AI and machine learning to scale security decisions, automate defenses, and move faster than emerging threats. You will own ambiguous, multi team initiatives end to end: defining program strategy, aligning engineering, science, legal, and product partners, and delivering measurable outcomes. You will operate at the intersection of security engineering, AI/ML, and healthcare regulation, translating fuzzy problems into crisp plans and shipping them.

Key job responsibilities
Own the lifecycle and strategy of large, complex, cross functional security programs across multiple engineering teams, from problem definition through launch and operational readiness.

Drive technical decisions and tradeoffs with engineering and applied science leaders, diving deep into architecture, threat models, and data handling design.

Build and manage program roadmaps, dependencies, and risk registers, proactively removing blockers.

Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to meet regulatory requirements such as HIPAA and related health data standards.

Champion an AI First approach, applying generative AI and automation to scale threat detection and accelerate reviews, while managing the risks AI systems introduce.

Author crisp narratives, including mechanism docs, program plans, and MBR and QBR content, for senior leadership.

Report on program metrics, tie outcomes to organization goals, contribute to OP1 and OP2 narratives, and define operational health for Tier 1 support.

Influence without authority across a VP organization, aligning senior managers, directors, and system owners with competing priorities.

Force multiply across teams, removing systemic blockers and driving simplification in engineering processes and architectures.

Eliminate excess process, creating predictable mechanisms and paths to green that raise the delivery bar.

Mentor and develop other program managers, and contribute to hiring and technical promotion assessments.


About the team
The Amazon Healthcare Security (HealthSec) team safeguards the data, devices, and systems at the core of Amazon’s healthcare business. We own the security of highly sensitive protected health information (PHI) and the trust patients and customers place in us. We are an AI First team: we embed security and privacy by design, partner with builders early to prevent issues before they ship, and apply generative AI and automation to scale threat detection and stay ahead of a fast evolving threat landscape. We hold ourselves to a bar exceeding strict regulatory requirements, and measure success by risk reduced for patients.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Technical Product Owner

About the Company

JAVLN helps insurance intermediaries evolve into super powered risk advisers. Our vision is to be the global, AI-native operating system for insurance intermediaries: the gold standard for how risk is managed in the digital age.

We're building a world class company across our products, customer experience, financial performance and culture. That takes A-players who drive change rather than wait for it, pairing sharp thinking with deep industry expertise.

Four values shape how we work: we are team players, we relentlessly innovate, we care about the work we do and we keep things simple.

Role Overview

This Technical Product Owner role is built for someone who has lived in a hybrid Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner role and wants to be part of the next frontier of delivering AI-first SaaS products.

The work you'll do decides whether a feature succeeds: understanding the customer, writing specifications that are precise enough for an agent to build from and the judgement call at each decision gate. The delivery mechanics that fill most Product Owner calendars? AI agents will handle those.

You'll sit inside a JAVLN AI Value Pod, working closely with a Product Manager and Senior Software Engineer alongside a set of AI agents, shipping features on JAVLN Officetech, one of our globally successful SaaS products. The agents write the code, the tests and the documentation, the humans instruct and verify.

A Value Pod is a small team embedding AI into a disciplined, governed lifecycle. Humans make the decisions that matter, controls are automated, and continuous validation of AI output means the pod delivers in days rather than weeks.

The Product Manager sets direction and decides what matters most across the roadmap. You decide how that direction becomes a sequenced, buildable backlog, and what "done" means for each item.

If you have been waiting for a role where AI fluency is the job rather than a line in the tooling section, this is it!

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirement elaboration and business analysis: Own the detailed analysis. Translate customer and business requirements into clear, unambiguous requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Map user journeys. Identify gaps, conflicts and dependencies. These outputs give AI agents the precision they need to deliver great outcomes.
  • Customer representation: Be the voice of the customer within the pod, so delivered features solve real user problems and reflect genuine business value rather than technical completeness alone.
  • Technical fluency: Engage directly with customers to understand and capture the high-level technical elements of what they need, which may include data modelling, integrations and API contracts, so requirements are accurate, validated and a solid starting point for the engineering work that follows.
  • Validation and quality: As part of authoring the requirements specification, define acceptance criteria, design test scenarios, and work with AI to build and run automated tests. Review and validate AI-generated work against requirements on an ongoing basis to catch deviations, gaps and risks early, and assess the quality of delivered features against the specification.
  • Backlog ownership and prioritisation: Own, order and continuously refine the product backlog within the direction set with the Product Manager. Manage dependencies so the backlog reflects near real-time priorities at a cadence suited to delivering in small sequential batches.
  • Outcome measurement: Define, capture and track product feature KPIs to give ongoing, quantifiable measurement of feature success.

Key Skills and Experience

Experience and Knowledge
  • Proven Product Owner experience: 6+ years as a Product Owner or equivalent, owning a backlog and delivering value.
  • Business analysis capability: Strong, hands-on business analysis skills covering requirement elicitation, user-story mapping, gap analysis and precise acceptance criteria.
  • Technical fluency: Able to work closely with an engineer to understand and reason about high-level technical elements such as integration requirements, data and API contracts, security and governance. Comfortable with modern web user interfaces, domain/data modelling, APIs and API data formats, and competent using SQL for data analysis. A background working closely with engineering teams is expected.
  • Agentic tooling: Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude or Copilot, and examples of using modern AI tools to transform traditional processes and outcomes.
  • Non-functional requirements (advantageous): Confidence capturing and documenting non-functional requirements, for example performance, security and scalability.
  • Product analytics (advantageous): Experience defining and tracking product KPIs and working with analytics or product data to evidence outcomes.
Capabilities and Attributes
  • Specification excellence: Exceptional ability to write clear, specific, unambiguous requirements and tests. In an AI-first pod this is the highest leverage skill you have.
  • AI ways of working: Enthusiasm for AI-driven development and comfort working alongside agentic tools. Curiosity, adaptability and a growth mindset for AI is critical for this role.
  • Decisiveness and accountability: Sound judgement and the confidence to approve or challenge specifications, representing JAVLN and customer interests as the accountable human at each decision gate.
  • Communication and collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a small, cross-functional pod. You will facilitate synchronous collaboration, drive rapid decision-making and partner closely with a Product Manager

Live the Values

  • We are TEAM players
  • We relentlessly INNOVATE
  • We CARE about the work we do
  • We keep things SIMPLE

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Prinsco is looking for a Field Service Technician who values safety, teamwork, and solving problems in real time. This role supports plant operations by installing, maintaining, and repairing equipment while helping ensure reliable and safe production across locations.

The right person enjoys hands on technical work, learning new systems, and supporting others. You will work closely with plant teams to troubleshoot issues, improve equipment performance, and support continuous improvement through dependable field support.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong mechanical and technical skills with a service mindset and a commitment to our mission to care, to contribute, and to solve.

Position Summary
The Field Service Technician role provides support for the installation, repair and maintenance of the
plant facilities' equipment, including emergency/unscheduled repairs or adjustments, while maintaining
safe work practices. This role reports to the Field Service Manager.
Accountabilities
• Technical Support/Diagnostics/Troubleshooting/Repaire
• Cross-training and Development
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Support the installation, repair and maintenance of production machines and plant equipment.
• Perform scheduled maintenance and repairs of production equipment.
• Complete emergency/unscheduled repairs of production equipment as assigned.
• Detect potential equipment failures, perform diagnostics, and corrective or preventative action.
• Provide oversight (verbally and/or onsite) for maintenance functions, preventative maintenance, or
troubleshooting equipment that is not functioning properly or has broken down.
• Provide production and/or equipment training at assigned plants.
• Read and interpret equipment manuals and work orders to perform required maintenance and
service.
• Support and assist in safety improvement projects at assigned plants.
• Provide input with technological and equipment advancement opportunities
• Identify and recommend changes to equipment or processes to improve safety and/or efficiency.
• Support equipment and process upgrades for new production methods or products.
• Compete electric work as per job requirements and training under NFPA 70E electrical and arch
flash requirements.
• Focus on cross-training, continuous learning, and improvement.
• Complete other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
• Secondary degree preferred, with a minimum of one year of manufacturing experience required.
• Experience in extrusion strongly preferred but not required; experience in hydraulic, pneumatic,
mechanical, and industrial systems required.
• Strong electrical knowledge for this job is required under NFPA 70E electrical standard. We will train
the right candidate.
• Experienced in cutting and welding (MIG, TIG, wire, plasma) strongly preferred.
• Forklift experience preferred with the ability to achieve a forklift certification.
• Strong influencing skills with the ability to communicate verbally and in writing with all levels of the
organization.
• Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to analyze data/facts/drawings to support valid
conclusions and to solve practical problems. Ability to deal with a variety of concrete variables in
situations where only limited standardization exists.
• Proficient with MS Office products and drafting software (Solidworks and/or AutoCAD). Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
• Ability to meet the physical requirements of the job: lift up to 50 lbs. 1/3 of the day and 75 lbs. less
than 1/3 of the workday; using hands and reaching with hands/arms for over 2/3 of the workday.
• Standing, walking, climbing or balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching or crawling for over 2/3 of
the workday.
• Distance v ision (clear v ision at 20 feet or more), per ipheral vision, d epth perceptio n, and the ability
to differentiate colors.
• Ability to work in a production environment that is not temperature controlled and occasionally in
varying outdoor weather conditions.
• Ability to work in a loud noise environment.
• Valid driver's license and clean driving record. With the ability to obtain a DOT medical card.
• Flexible travel up to 50%.
