title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Networking (MONA)
description:
AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world, and MONA (Management, Out-of-Band Networks, and Automation) alone owns the full lifecycle of over one million physical devices. We are in the critical path for every new data center powering the AI revolution.

Everything we run, we build in-house: controllers, software-defined networking (SDN), and planning software. For example, we own a controller for agentic network auto-remediation, and the planning software that plans every new data center down to capacity and ports. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to own the design and delivery of core components of these systems end-to-end — from design through production — and to keep growing your technical scope. You do not need a networking background up front; strong engineers learn our domain here, on a team that invests in your growth and gives you real ownership at a scale almost nowhere else can offer.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the design, implementation, and operation of well-scoped components and features of our in-house network software — controllers, SDN, planning software, and out-of-band systems — end-to-end.
- Turn ambiguous requirements into high-quality, well-tested, scalable code; contribute to design docs and design reviews.
- Operate your services in production and uphold high operational standards, improving monitoring and alarming as you go.
- Drive correctness and safety for automation that acts on production networks: idempotency, guardrails, and observability that proves work actually happened.
- Collaborate with your team and partner teams to evolve the product and continuously improve code, processes, and quality.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team through thoughtful code reviews.
- Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.


A day in the life
You own a component end-to-end: you write the design, build it, ship it, and operate it. One morning you are extending our controller for agentic network auto-remediation; the next you are improving how the planning software allocates ports and capacity for a new data center build. You will make a teammate's change better in review, tighten operational excellence on your service, and help a junior engineer level up — all on systems that run at a scale almost nowhere else can offer, with real ownership and teammates sharp enough to make you better.


About the team
MONA (Management, Out-of-Band Networks, and Automation) is part of AWS Networking. We are a highly motivated team of software, systems, and network developers who thrive on solving challenging problems and building large-scale distributed systems. AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world, and MONA alone owns the full lifecycle of over a million physical devices. Everything we run we build in-house: controllers, software-defined networking, planning software, and out-of-band management systems.

title: CLS I (PD - VARIABLE)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Analyzes specimens and performs laboratory testing procedures in accordance with established and approved protocol, which require the exercise and independent judgment and interpretation. Must be able to perform jobs in all patient care and operational areas subject to reasonable accommodations, also be able to employ all mandatory safety devices and procedures. This is a union position. See essential job functions and competency based classifications for Clinical Laboratory Scientist.

Completes all Pre-Analytical Responsibilities

· Biological specimen collection including; patient preparation, labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, inoculation, subculturing or staining, transportation and storage of specimens, receives collects and delivers to appropriate departments. Confirms completeness of the test requisition and tests orders

· Verifies specimens are labeled accurately and that minimal labeling requirements are met.

· Verifies specimen type and integrity, identifies, researches and corrects routine problems.

· Checks for specimen source or site for microbiology samples

· Verifies specimen collection date and time.

· Checks for duplication collections. Example: One blood culture set per draw site.

· Accessions specimens into the laboratory computer system, recording accurate collection time and specimen.

· Prepares specimens for analysis while maintaining correct and complete identification and using appropriate centrifuge methods to ensure specimen quality.

· Follows through and documents non-blood specimen collection, prepares collection material, measures specimens, records and forwards pertinent information necessary for the accurate calculation of the test results.

· Biological specimen collection, including patient preparation, labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, inoculation, subculturing or staining and transportation and storage of specimen

· Utilizes materials and procedures required for quality control of testing processes adhering to established laboratory protocol and/or Westgard rules.

· Must know operational procedure for the Computerized Tube System.

Completes all Analytical Responsibilities

· Analyzes specimens following standard methods and procedures. Performing testing in accordance with assigned section policies and procedures i.e. Coagulation, Chemistry, Hematology/ Serology, Body Fluids/ Urinalysis, Transfusion Service, and Microbiology.

· Assists with testing in all departments as necessary to maintain optimum processing of results. Demonstrates ability to set priorities. Adheres to laboratory policy concerning STAT testing, delta checks, critical values and abnormal values. Telephones or faxes results as appropriate within the acceptable time frame.

· Makes decisions involving test validity, monitoring testing for deviation from acceptable limits, is able to initiate retesting when required and alerts Laboratory Director or Supervisor of errors or shortcomings in the testing processes.

· Responds to changes in work as required, assisting with testing in all depts as necessary to maintain optimum processing of results.

· Must know down time procedure for both the computer and instrumentation and the process for reporting computer problems on the off shifts. Must be familiar with send out procedures for after hour transport of send out testing. Must know the send out procedure for down instrumentation.

Completes all Post-Analytical Responsibilities

· Maintains laboratory records, log sheets, worksheets and paper work. Documents and signs work acknowledging responsibility. Reviews pending logs at the end of the shift to determine status of incomplete work. Prepares the End of Shift Report (EOSR) and communicates with staff on the next shift to make sure there are no gaps in service.

· Ensure that telephone calls are answered and that all reports are reported in a timely manner.

· Handle customer service complaints and intercede to correct problems, resolving issues that can be dealt with and communicating with Supervisor all client service and employee issues that need further attention.

Completes all Department Responsibilities

· Performs instrument / equipment preventative maintenance procedures as required, documenting and reporting malfunctions to Laboratory Director or Supervisor.

· Inspects equipment, troubleshoot failures and take corrective action as necessary, calling for instrument technical service as required.

· Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with all levels of staff within the laboratory, nursing staff, and physicians. Contributes to teamwork and harmonious working relationships by communicating effectively and appropriately to resolve problems. Must be able to carryout instructions while working alone with little supervision.

· Monitors inventory in all lab departments, making sure supplies are restocked, ordered and/ or put away.

· Participates in the proficiency testing surveys including specimen preparation, analysis, and reporting, and additionally participates in annual competency testing for all departments.

· Oversees and delegates duties to the Laboratory Technical Assistant (LTA) including but not limited to: quality control, calibration, linearity, calibration verification setup, inventory, ordering, and maintenance, troubleshooting and testing of proficiency surveys. The duties should be coordinated with a team work approach.

· Actively cross-train in all eight (8) disciplines performed by the laboratory.

· Demonstrates competency in all eight (8) disciplines performed by the laboratory within one (1) year of employment.

· Masters one general laboratory section, (blood bank).

· Demonstrates the ability to resolve technical situations at a basic level, referring complicated situations to another CLS I, or CLS II, CLS III, Supervisor, or Director.

· Must be able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of staff within the laboratory.

· Takes an active role in providing training and assists new personnel in department orientation. Acts as a resource for new personnel.

· Assists CLS Supervisor in the coordination and training of CLS and MLT students.

· Demonstrates and supports the integrated automated Core Laboratory operations and its mission to provide patient test information accurately and efficiently to the caregivers of the hospital, which impacts value base purchasing.

· Demonstrates and supports working with the hospital and the Core Laboratory in raising efficiency, productivity, and reducing operating cost and waste.

title: Network Deploy Technician, Global Network Delivery (GND)
description:
At Amazon, we're working to be Earth's most Customer-centric Company and Earth's Best Employer. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build and expand the Cloud, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
- Collaboration with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
- Troubleshoot networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low level application interaction
- Up to 20% travel within geographical work area is required. Some travel outside traditional work area may be requested, including internationally
- Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords
- Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment

**Any physical requirements are expectations with reasonable accommodations

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Business Analyst - Planning, Funding & Outcomes
company: Health New Zealand - Te Whatu Ora
description:
• 6 month fixed-term opportunity working remotely from anywhere in New Zealand, or with a home base in Wellington or North Shore, Auckland
  • A unique opportunity to play a key role in delivering a Lung Screening Mobile Pilot and improving equitable health outcomes
  • Work with clinicians, digital teams, and national stakeholders to shape a future national screening programme

Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora is the country's largest employer, delivering universal public healthcare to 5 million New Zealanders.

We provide essential hospital, specialist, and community health services across 80+ locations — from large urban centres to rural towns and remote communities.

Our goal is to improve health outcomes for all New Zealanders by delivering equitable, accessible and innovative care.

About the Role

The Business Analyst will play a critical role in supporting the successful planning and implementation of the Lung Screening Mobile Pilot. The pilot builds on the learnings from Te Oranga Pūkahukahu - The Lung Cancer Screening Research Programme, which has been testing different screening approaches since 2020. The pilot will test and refine a mobile screening model designed to improve equitable access to lung screening and inform the implementation of a future national programme.

Working closely with pilot leaders, Digital Services, clinicians, operational stakeholders, and external partners, you will gather, analyse, and document business requirements primarily in the Digital workstream, but also across other workstreams. You will develop process maps, workflows, business requirements, and supporting documentation to ensure solutions are fit for purpose and aligned with programme objectives, operational needs, and equity outcomes.

You will work in close partnership with the Digital Delivery team to ensure alignment between programme objectives and digital delivery, managing dependencies across applications, infrastructure, data, integration, security, and service transition activities. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to an innovative initiative expected to improve access to early detection services and deliver better outcomes for New Zealanders.

The pilot is a partnership between Planning, Funding & Outcomes and National Public Health Services, working closely with Hawkes Bay and Lakes Districts

About the Project

The Lung Screening Mobile Pilot is a nationally significant initiative that will help shape the future of lung cancer screening in Aotearoa New Zealand. Building on the learnings from The Lung Cancer Screening Research Programme. The pilot has been established to test and refine the feasibility, effectiveness, and equity of mobile screening delivery. Operating across the Hawke's Bay and Lakes districts, the programme will bring screening closer to communities, improve access to early detection, and support better health outcomes through the identification of lung cancers at an earlier, more treatable stage.

About you

As an experienced Business Analyst, you'll bring strong analytical capability, excellent relationship management skills, and a passion for improving health outcomes through effective service and system design.

You will ideally have:

  • A relevant tertiary qualification
  • Experience working in a Business Analyst or similar role
  • Proven experience gathering, analysing, validating, and documenting business requirements
  • Experience developing process maps, workflows, user stories, service pathways, and business documentation
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including facilitating workshops and working across multidisciplinary teams
  • Experience translating complex operational, clinical, and technical requirements into practical solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement
  • Experience working in the health sector, government, or similarly complex environments
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in evolving and ambiguous environments
  • A commitment to Te Tiriti o Waitangi and improving equity outcomes for Māori, Pacific peoples, and other priority populations

Desirable experience includes familiarity with health sector data standards and digital environments such as FHIR, HL7, Snowflake, or similar platforms.

Working at Health New Zealand

Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora is dedicated to ensuring excellent healthcare for the people of New Zealand. We embrace a workforce that is diverse and inclusive so that we are better positioned to understand and service our community. We welcome applications from our diverse Māori, Pacific, disabled, and rainbow communities.

How to Apply

To apply, please click "apply now." All applications must be submitted through our online careers' portal by 11:59PM Wednesday 9 September 2026. For further information, please contact Lynda Francis on lynda.francis@tewhatuora.govt.nz

We will review applications as received and may proceed with the recruitment process before the closing date of this advert.

title: Crisis Specialist , Global Security Organization (GSO)
description:
The mission of Amazon’s Worldwide Operational Security (WWOS) organization is to mitigate security and operational risks to our associates, data, and physical assets. Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual who can provide strategic, high-level guidance to mitigate risk and coordinate an effective response during worldwide crisis management events.

The Crisis Specialist (CS) position is based out of Amazon's Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) in Goodyear, AZ. The GSOC provides: global, regional, and localized crisis management response, coordination and facilitation, security risk monitoring and subject matter expertise, assistance with alarm/video monitoring services for Amazon's operational locations, and response to significant workplace violence or critical incidents, among other daily services and projects.

Demonstrated ownership, critical thinking, customer obsession, good judgment, and concise verbal and writing skills are crucial requirements for this role, as well as a desire to drive change through creation of policies and procedures, making recommendations to the business for process improvement and capacity increases, and providing expert advice to our customers and management teams.

Shift work will be required, potentially to include nights, weekends, and public holidays.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead real-time risk assessment and response for incidents affecting Amazon Associates and/or 3rd party delivery partners - Provide expert guidance to front line teams on incident response protocols
- Analyze incident data to identify trends and recommend process improvements
- Analyze incident information, decide what resources are required to resolve the incident, communicate the plan to achieve objectives, and direct resources accordingly
- Coordinate cross-functional response teams during critical incidents
- Lead and support projects that streamline and enhance the crisis response process


A day in the life
As a Crisis Specialist, you serve as the first line of support for frontline Amazon Associates, triaging calls from sites, drivers, and customers experiencing incidents or crises. You evaluate severity, provide expert guidance to mitigate risk, and escalate higher-severity incidents as needed. Using high-level judgment, you coordinate action to minimize life safety issues, operational disruptions, and brand impact in accordance with Amazon procedures and industry best practices. You communicate effectively under ambiguity, adapt to evolving technology and shifting priorities, and maintain subject matter expertise across Amazon tools.

About the team
The Global Security Operations Center works with global stakeholders to provide critical support and notification to global partners regarding incidents that have, or have the potential to, impact Life Safety, Operations, and/or the Amazon Brand.

title: Legal Secretary I
description:
Position: Legal Secretary I

Department: Legal

Reports To: Sr. Assistant General Counsel

Location: 7450 Campus Drive, Suite 200, Colorado Springs, CO 80920

Remote: NO

Non-Exempt: YES

Compensation & Benefits: $24.23 to $27.55 per hour, depending on experience

Mortgage Solutions of Colorado, LLC d/b/a Mortgage Solutions Financial (“MSF”) offers a comprehensive benefit package and PTO (paid time off) for eligible employees. The benefit package includes Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, options to participate in a Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, Life and AD&D coverage, voluntary Supplemental Life, voluntary Short-Term, Long-Term Disability and Supplemental insurance. In addition, eligible employees have the option to participate in a company retirement plan.

About MSF

MSF is a national mortgage lender based in Colorado Springs. MSF strongly believes every client should be served with integrity, dignity, and respect. Without compromise, MSF is committed to providing loans that are in the best interest of our clients, not our bottom line. We will continue to educate the community by empowering our clients to make responsible and informed fiscal decisions that result in greater financial peace of mind.

Role Overview

The Legal Secretary I provides core administrative and secretarial support to in-house counsel, paralegals, and the broader administrative, legal, and compliance teams. Under direct supervision, this role maintains organized file structures, assists with document preparation, manages office supplies, and ensures accurate invoice processing. The position requires strict confidentiality, strong foundational clerical skills, and the ability to apply company policies to daily tasks.

Essential Functions

  • Perform secretarial duties under direct supervision to support the company's attorneys, paralegals, and legal teams.
  • Maintain legal records, corporate files, and centralized document management systems for in-house counsel and leadership.
  • Prepare standard legal papers, briefs, and routine borrower or business correspondence.
  • Schedule meetings, coordinate legal team calendars, and arrange travel.
  • Monitor and maintain legal office supply inventory by checking stock levels and placing orders.
  • Prepare legal vendor invoices, track payments, and route records to accounting.
  • Safeguard client, borrower, and attorney information to keep all matters strictly confidential.
  • Support routine administrative functions across General Counsel, Licensing, Facilities, and customer service areas.
  • Handle basic issues and problems, referring more complex operational or legal matters to higher-level staff.
  • Help organize written and electronic company policies to support consistency and easy access.
  • Perform basic legal research, administrative errands, and document collection tasks as directed by legal counsel.
  • Provide coverage and back-up support for our front lobby operations by greeting guests, issuing visitor badges, escorting visitors, inventory, supply ordering, breakroom cleaning and handling incoming phone inquiries.

title: Chief Engineer, Data Centre Engineering Operations, Data Centre Engineering Operations
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As Chief Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. You are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers.

You should be able to manage large scale impacting projects and new region support from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, procurement, and finance in both local and global settings. As Chief Engineer, you will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the Chief Engineers to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.



Key job responsibilities
- Train and support the Engineering team in their role of providing electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations
- Implement and execute site or equipment-specific training exercises. Exercises cover, but are not limited to: stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers etc.
- Oversee day-to-day operation and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in data center sites
- Operate independently, with limited direct management
- Assist in the design and build-out of new facilities and perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center region. Work OT hours as needed to support site stability
- Troubleshoot and report facility and data sever-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Create and deploy standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendors, and AWS staff
- Respond to off hour emergency calls related to his data centers and help with the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s).
- Candidates should be able to lift up to 40 lbs and or work in elevated locations.
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to provide after-hours support as needed. All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Work at height, and from ladders
- Perform physical tasks during the shift
- Work in a noisy environment, with ear protection

About the team
About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

description:

title: RN Unit Based PRN (6312)
description:
A Brief Overview

Provides professional nursing care to patients within assigned unit/area utilizing the nursing process to assess, plan, implement and evaluate patient care. Works flexible work schedules within service line in accordance with Float Pool staffing guidelines.

What you will do

  • Provides nursing care according to medical regime and the nursing intervention appropriate for the patients' conditions and according to established standards, policies and procedures including care of the medicine and surgery patient. * Initiates assessment based on the patient's presenting problems or needs, the physician's medical diagnosis and the functional health framework upon admission and patient assignment. * Collects key information from patient, family, laboratory, and other medical reports. * Determines nursing diagnosis and priorities for care with special consideration given to patient teaching, discharge planning, and the growth and development needs of the patient. * Determines which standards of care and practice apply to the patient. * Documents assessment, including nursing diagnoses or other clinical judgments. * Demonstrates knowledge and technical, interpersonal and critical thinking skills to provide care, maintain clinical competency and meet age-specific patient needs within the unit. * Demonstrates ability to manage the care of patients with conditions common to the assigned unit.
  • Performs clinical rounds and completes ongoing assessments according to nursing division policy and/or as determined by patient condition, re-prioritizes care based on new information, continues to update nursing diagnoses, and involves family and/or other significant individuals in assessment activities.
  • Assesses plans and implements care of assigned patients. Performs therapeutic nursing interventions as ordered by the Physician, consistent with primary and population-specific standards of care and practice, with consideration given to knowledge gained from the initial and ongoing assessment of the patient. * Consistent with nursing division policies and procedures, demonstrated competencies, and with consideration given to risk management, infection control practices, and patient safety practices. * Consistent with the nature of the assigned unit, including but not limited to, admission/assessment interventions, administration of medication (IM, IV, SQ, PO), pain management measures. * Prepares and maintains required records, reports and files for administrative and compliance purposes. * Maintains a clean, orderly, safe environment for patients and personnel. Adheres to established policies, compliance/quality improvement, and safety, environment and infection control standards.
  • Determines the impact of nursing interventions on the patient's condition and recognizes the patient's progress towards meeting desired outcomes.
  • Documents care based on standards of care and practice and/or clinical priorities for documentation including, assessment and ongoing assessment findings, updated clinical priorities for documentation, therapeutic nursing interventions with special attention to patient education and discharge planning interventions, and patient’s response to interventions and progress towards outcomes are noted.
  • Prepares equipment/supplies and assists physician during treatments, procedures and examinations. Performs specialized duties applicable to assigned unit.
  • Responds and/or participates with medical emergencies. Initiates and/or assists with CPR/BLS/ACLS as required.
  • Provides teaching to patient/family in the care of disease/condition. Develops and implements patient teaching outlines including objectives, content, teaching strategies and evaluation of patient progress.
  • Maintains patient medical records; documents patient status and care given; performs charting duties; records activities and observations. Utilizes patient computer systems to enter and retrieve data.
  • Confers and works collaboratively with patient/family/hospital staff regarding all aspects of patient needs (i.e., patient admission/discharge of/transfer process, discharge planning, referrals, coordinating exams/therapy/rehab, requisitions for supplies, obtains medical records, etc.) in a customer responsive and courteous manner, in compliance with Premier Behavior Standards and promoting patient/customer satisfaction.
  • Provides instruction, assigns and supervises LPN and other support personnel assigned to unit to complete the initial and ongoing assessments of patients and to provide clinical assistance as needed. Assists in the orientation and oversee the supervision of new staff members and students when they provide patient care, treatment, and services as part of their training.
  • Transports monitored patients, specimens, equipment and supplies to and from various areas.
  • Collaborates with forensic team and security to provide safe environment for patients in custody.
  • Completes required continuous training and education, including department specific requirements. Maintains required licensures/certifications required within assigned units/areas.
  • Works flexible work schedule within assigned service line in accordance with float pool staffing guidelines.

description:

We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute, and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in AR develop.

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment.

This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.


Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management.

The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation.

title: Senior Human Resource Generalist
description:
The Senior HR Generalist is responsible for implementing and administering human resource policies and programs that require sound, independent judgment on employee relations and compliance matters, that will enable The Children's Receiving Home (CRH) to achieve its mission and vision. The Senior HR Generalist provides technical and administrative staff expertise and support on a variety of related issues including, but not limited to, the areas of Employee Relations, Wage and Salary, Benefits, Leave Administration, Staff Development, Recruitment and Retention, Employment, Workplace Safety, etc. Develops and implements HR policies, programs and procedures to ensure accountability, equity and fairness throughout the agency and consistent compliance with all regulatory and accrediting agencies in addition to State and Federal legal requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Overall Department Administration

  • Implement and administer HR programs, policies and procedures.
  • Ensures that HR policies and procedures manuals are current, reflect the needs of the organization and are reviewed annually.
  • Advise management and staff of required updates to policies and procedures as a result of changes in statutory regulations or laws and communicates, monitors and implements as needed.
  • Provide leadership and direction on HR matters that pertain to the agency.
  • Maintain knowledge and understanding of Federal and State labor laws to ensure compliance with all personnel related legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Advises, guides, counsels, interprets and makes recommendations regarding HR policies, objectives, operational procedures, statutory regulations/laws and compliance activities to all levels of staff.
  • Assist staff in resolving employee relations issues including, but not limited to, involuntary termination, employee disciplinary action and grievances.
  • Monitors all grievances to ensure timely and effective resolution of employee concerns.
  • Develop and monitor compensation program, ensuring that it is consistently administered throughout the agency.
  • Conduct salary surveys to maintain competitive pay ranges and employee benefits as needed.
  • Conduct an annual review of employee benefits plans.
  • Ensures that all Wage and Salary and Benefits programs are current, legal, administered consistently and meet agency needs.
  • In coordination with Finance, negotiate benefit program and Workers' Compensation premiums each year to provide maximum savings for the agency.
  • Plan and oversee annual open enrollment period for employees.
  • Ensure that accurate, legally compliant, criteria-based job descriptions have been developed and kept current for each position.
  • Assist management staff in revising and creating job descriptions when needed.
  • Develop and implement a Recruitment and Retention plan to maintain adequate employees for agency programs.
  • Oversee the performance and salary review process for all staff.
  • Develop and implement a criteria-based performance evaluation system. Regularly monitor for effectiveness.
  • Responsible for all issues pertaining to workers compensation.
  • Ensures complete and orderly personnel files and other HR records are always maintained in compliance with legal and agency standards.
  • Assures the confidentiality of all personnel files and documentation.

Personnel Management

  • Serve as the primary HR advisor and point of contact for program directors, managers, supervisors, and staff CRH-wide.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance and skills training is available to CRH staff (e.g., harassment prevention, workplace safety, mandated reporter, policy training).
  • Own the hiring, discharge, and orientation process in accordance with agency policy.
  • Oversee disciplinary actions, in compliance with agency policies and procedures.

CRH Activities

  • Attend and participate in CRH management and Leadership meetings.
  • Oversee the Employee Recognition Committee and Safety Committee.
  • Participate in New Employee Orientation as needed.
  • Participate in CRH activities as required.
  • Perform other job duties as assigned.

Fiscal Management

  • Works closely with the agency's Finance department to develop program budgets and monitor monthly budget expenditures.
  • In conjunction with Finance, prepare program budget amendments as needed.
  • Coordinate with Finance to ensure timely submission of accurate time sheets and attendance reports.

Quality Improvement

  • Conduct internal program evaluations and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain program compliance with agency, Federal and/or State regulations.
  • Ensure compliance with all records, files, and HR related information.
  • Recommend to the Leadership team educational and organization development programs that may be beneficial.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

None

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech AI, Amazon Robotics - S&O - PACE
description:
The Amazon Tech Deployment (TD) PACE (Product, Analytics and Customer Experience) team within S&O (Strategy and Operations) Organization is seeking a senior product manager – technical (PM-T) to drive customer relationship and product strategy. This PM-T will focus on AI Tools and Insights, that facilitate the organization in making data driven bar raising decisions. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with some of the best engineers in the industry and shape the direction of one of the world’s largest robotics driven fulfillment networks.

TD is a multifaceted organization composed of teams which invent for rapid scaling of complex technical solutions, develop products for industrial equipment automation, and provide business intelligence analytics and tooling. These hardware and software tools improve deployment quality, cost, speed and add features that reduce complexity for ease of use and operational excellence.

The focus of this Sr. PM-T role is the software products, systems, tools, and AI Agents used to manage deployment of Amazon fulfillment center technology globally. These software products are leveraged by Amazon internal project managers, Amazon internal program managers, and internal and external installers. The scope of these products include functionality such as: project initiation, project planning, project execution, project monitoring & control, project budgeting, mobile application access, standard work instruction, task automation, and accessibility. The products standardize, track, and enables automation in deployment execution which improves reliability and repeatability of Amazon’s deployment and testing processes.

In TD, our Sr. PM-Ts are expected to listen attentively and speak candidly. Those conversations start with our customers and work backwards to collaborate with our development teams in the TD organization. Our PM-Ts seek data and diverse perspectives and use that insight to respectfully challenge decisions. We push ourselves and our development teams to accomplish more with less. We think big and do not sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Your success as a TD Sr. PM-T will be measured on ROI (known internally as entitlement), customer satisfaction, and attainment of the product’s committed benefits.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and drive AI product strategy across the Tech Deployment lifecycle, leveraging GenAI and machine learning technologies to build innovative products/services that support growth and optimize workflows, and continuously drive product success post launch.
- Translate complex AI/ML capabilities into intuitive product experiences, clearly defining product requirements that balance technical feasibility with user needs and business impact.
- Drive responsible AI practices, ensuring products meet quality, fairness, and safety standards while delivering business value.
- Work with technology teams to develop AI products, evaluate AI/ML model performance, resolve issues, and manage development cycles with understanding of AI product development lifecycle.

- Partner daily with engineering, applied science, and design to sequence and ship a roadmap tied to measurable outcomes.
- Define success metrics and KPIs for AI products, establishing frameworks to measure product performance, user adoption, and business impact post-launch
- Make build-versus-integrate and prioritization calls under real constraints, balancing near-term delivery needs against building a durable, scalable platform.
- Communicate at the right altitude, from detailed product reviews to executive narratives and live demos, and report progress through our business review mechanisms.
- Stay current with AI/ML trends and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to incorporate new capabilities into the product roadmap.

A day in the life

- Write the narratives that define what we build and why — PR/FAQs, PRDs, tenets, and success metrics — and drive them through delivery and QA with Engineering and Science.

title: Assistant (secretaresse) Litigation
description:

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning van verschillende advocaten. Je draagt onder andere zorg voor efficiënt agendabeheer en het plannen en voorbereiden van afspraken en vergaderingen. Een enthousiaste collega die ervoor zorgt dat voor zijn/haar advocaten alles op rolletjes loopt. Je hebt een afgeronde MBO(+)/HBO opleiding. Wat bieden wij?

Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie, met de mogelijkheid jezelf te ontplooien. Een goede werksfeer en een fijne werkomgeving in een prachtig gebouw, dat is gericht op transparantie en samenwerking. Natuurlijk ook een goed salaris en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden waar wij je graag meer over vertellen.

Interesse?

Aarzel dan niet en reageer snel! Wil je aanvullende informatie over de functie? Dan kun je contact opnemen met Margriet Augstein via onderstaande contactgegevens.

title: Rail Freight Administrator - Temp to Hire
description:
Job Title: Rail Freight Administrator - Temp to Hire

Department: Corporate Office

Reports To: Domestic Freight Supervisor

Compensation: DOE

Organizational Background

Columbia Grain International, LLC is a global leader in the origination, processing, logistics and distribution of high-quality bulk grains, pulses, edible beans, oilseeds, and organics for domestic and worldwide export markets. We are headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and we own and operate over 50 facilities, including grain elevators and pulse processing plants across WA, ID, MT, NE, and ND.

At all levels of our organization, our employees are some of the most experienced and knowledgeable in the industry. We've spent over 40 years cultivating lasting partnerships with a wide network of producers and the local communities surrounding our facilities, which enables us to source the highest quality product and to fulfill our mission of feeding the world.

Position Description

The Rail Freight Administrator supports the Domestic Freight Supervisor through a series of daily, weekly and monthly tasks related to freight accruals, processing of freight invoices and analysis of potential demurrage claims, along with processing rail shipment documentation. The Rail Freight Administrator is a point of contact for internal and external customers, providing shipment information to accounting, bills of lading, freight invoices and secondary market trades. The Rail Freight Administrator will work with the other members of the Freight team to achieve operational goals while maintaining quality and efficiencies.

title: Night Data Center Technician
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

NOTE: This is a night shift role that requires an overnight work schedule from approx. 6pm to 6:30am


Key job responsibilities
• Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
• Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
• Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
• Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
• Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
• Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
• Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
• Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

title: Product Manager, AIRX
description:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

AI Innovation and Research Accelerator (AIRX) is a part of AIR, a standalone team within Platforms and Devices (P&D), that is known for building cutting-edge AI product experiences and getting them to billions of users.

You will build the next generation of user experiences across P&D by building on frontier AI model and partnering directly with Google Play Product and Engineering teams to turn green-field research into shipped impact for developers and users.

Working at AIRX, you can expect to:

  • Build products and define the path from zero-to-one.
  • Build bridges between exceptional research and product execution by fostering consensus and collaboration.
  • See your work move from research to shipped products quickly.
  • Outsize impact by operating across various product areas, influencing how billions of users experience AI across the ecosystem.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

  • Lead 0-to-1 AI Product Incubation: Drive rapid prototyping and user-centric validation to test UX feasibility and establish product-market fit for novel consumer and developer surfaces across Google Play.
  • Bridge Frontier AI Research and Product Execution: Serve as the core liaison between AIR, Google DeepMind, and Google Play leadership to translate cutting-edge foundation models and agentic workflows into production-ready features.
  • Accelerate Ecosystem AI Integrations: Identify and deliver high-impact AI opportunities across key Play pillars, including the core Play Store experience, gaming, business generation, and developer tooling.
  • Lead Strategic Product Roadmaps: Define the goal and drive end-to-end execution for emerging initiatives such as AI-powered game development, automated store merchandising, and next-generation discovery.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment and Delivery: Manage multiple parallel workstreams, align stakeholder consensus across organizational boundaries, and lead initiatives from initial concept through to landing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a Technology or Business related field.
  • Experience in end-to-end foundation model integration, agentic workflows, and production performance trade-offs.
  • Ability to rapidly build functional POCs and validate hypotheses using AI-assisted coding tools.
  • Proven track record of incubating, validating, and launching 0-to-1 AI products from scratch.
  • Excellent product judgment and domain expertise across Google Play consumer surfaces, gaming, and developer ecosystems.
  • Excellent executive communication skills to influence cross-functional leaders and align strategic road-maps.

title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Billing
description:
Build the full-stack experiences that help millions of AWS customers understand and optimize their cloud spending. We own the console surfaces and services behind AWS Cost Explorer, BCM Dashboards, and AWS Budgets — and we're evolving them fast.

As an SDE 2, you'll own features end-to-end — from frontend React components to backend Java services to the operational health of what you ship. You'll design solutions to difficult problems: making cost data intuitive at massive scale, building managed dashboard experiences, and migrating millions of customers to modernized console architectures. You won't just implement specs — you'll work directly with product and UX to understand customer pain, propose approaches, and ship iteratively.

What makes this role compelling: · You'll work across the full stack — React/TypeScript frontends, Java/AWS backend services, CDK infrastructure — with real ownership, not ticket work · The problems are genuinely hard: multi-partition deployments, cost allocation at scale, and UX for data that is inherently complex · Our team uses AI tools daily as development partners · You'll mentor others, lead design reviews, and influence the team's technical direction — this is a role where your voice shapes the architecture

This isn't a maintenance role. We're actively rebuilding and modernizing core billing console experiences while launching net-new dashboard and AI-driven cost insight products. You're joining while the hard decisions are still being made.

Key job responsibilities
· Design and build full-stack features across AWS Cost Explorer, BCM Dashboards, and AWS Budgets — React/TypeScript frontends and Java backend services serving millions of AWS customers. · Own features through the full software lifecycle — from customer problem discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations. · Solve difficult problems at scale — cost data visualization, managed dashboard experiences, and console migration for millions of existing customers across multi-partition deployments. · Author technical design documents, lead design reviews, and provide meaningful code reviews that raise the team's code bar. · Drive operational excellence — own alarms, monitoring, runbooks, and on-call rotations for live production services; resolve root causes of systemic issues. · Mentor engineers, onboard new team members, and foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives shape technical decisions. · Collaborate with product management and UX to deeply understand customer pain points and translate them into incremental, shippable solutions. · Contribute to team technical strategy and roadmap — help decide where to invest, what to modernize, and what to deprecate. · Write clean, testable, production-ready code using AI-native development practices — leveraging GenAI tools as daily development partners.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a PR from a teammate who's building a new budget threshold visualization — you leave feedback on the API contract and suggest a simpler state management approach on the frontend. After standup, you spend an hour pairing with a junior engineer who's stuck on a CDK deployment issue across partitions.

Mid-morning, you dive into your main project: designing the backend service changes needed to support a new managed dashboard feature. You sketch out the API, think through edge cases (what happens when a customer has hundreds of linked accounts with different dashboard configurations?), and draft a design doc to share with the team.

After lunch, you notice an alarm firing for elevated latency on one of your team's Cost Explorer APIs. You pull up the dashboards, identify a query pattern that's inefficient for a new customer segment, and open a ticket to fix it — writing a quick runbook entry so the next on-call engineer won't have to re-investigate.

Late afternoon, you join a brainstorm with the team about where AI could improve the customer experience — could we use GenAI to help customers interpret cost trends, surface optimization recommendations, or simplify dashboard creation? You prototype a quick proof-of-concept using the same AI tools you've been coding with all day.

You end the day pushing code for a React component you've been building — a widget that makes multi-account cost trends scannable at a glance. It's behind a feature flag, shipping incrementally.

No two days are identical, but most combine: hands-on coding across the stack, mentoring, design thinking, operational awareness, and exploring how AI can make both our development and our customers' experience better.

About the team
We own the console experiences that millions of AWS customers use daily to understand and manage their cloud costs — Cost Explorer, BCM Dashboards, and AWS Budgets. We're not just maintaining these products; we're actively modernizing them while building net-new managed dashboard experiences and exploring how AI can fundamentally change how customers interact with cost data. We think about where GenAI fits — in how we build (AI-assisted development is part of our daily workflow) and in what we build (surfacing insights, simplifying complex data, making cost management conversational rather than dashboard-heavy). The culture is direct, collaborative, and low-ego. We ship iteratively, own what we build end-to-end, and invest in each other's growth. If you want a team where your ideas shape the product direction and your code ships to millions, this is it.

title: Data Engineer II, Fire TV

title: Healthcare Strategic Lead, UK Public Sector Healthcare
description:
AWS is seeking an experienced healthcare technology leader to drive long-term proposition development for the NHS. This is not a traditional sales role — it is a strategic, outward-facing position that combines deep NHS domain expertise with the ability to shape and architect cloud-enabled solutions that address the systemic challenges facing the health service.

You will act as the bridge between NHS clinical/operational reality and AWS's technology capabilities — translating policy intent into deliverable cloud propositions, working 12–36 months ahead of procurement cycles to shape demand, and ensuring AWS is positioned as the strategic platform of choice when buying decisions crystallise.

This role is ideal for someone with a CTO, CDIO, or senior digital leadership background in the NHS who wants to apply that expertise at national scale — shaping propositions that will transform care delivery across the system.

Key job responsibilities
1/ Develop and own long-term (2–5 year) cloud propositions aligned to NHS strategic priorities
2/ Translate NHS policy (10-Year Health Plan, NHSE mandates, ICS strategies) into actionable AWS account plans
3/ Engage at CIO, CDIO, CCIO, and Medical Director level as a credible peer — understanding clinical workflows, operational pressures, and governance constraints from first-hand experience
4/ Shape NHS procurement criteria and architecture standards ahead of formal tender processes
5/ Lead proposition development for complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives
6/ Work with AWS Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and ISVs to build reference architectures, business cases, and proof-of-concept designs
7/ Represent AWS at national policy forums, NHS boards, and industry bodies — contributing thought leadership on cloud-enabled health system transformation
8/ Advise the AWS UK Healthcare leadership team on NHS strategic direction, emerging opportunities, and competitive positioning
Build relationships across the NHS ecosystem: NHSE, DHSC, ICSs, NHS Trusts, Royal Colleges and regulators

A day in the life
No two days in this role are the same. On any given day, you might start the morning preparing a cloud business case for a Trust CFO and spend the afternoon on-site with a CDIO walking through their digital roadmap.

You'll balance strategic account planning with tactical deal execution — one moment you're working with a Trust's to shape their infrastructure strategy, the next you're navigating a procurement framework. You'll join internal working sessions with Solutions Architects to design a resilient architecture for a clinical workload, then brief your leadership on pipeline progress.

You'll attend NHS industry events and ICS board meetings and host innovation days that bring clinicians face-to-face with AI and data tools. Some weeks you'll be deep in a complex multi-stakeholder procurement; others you'll be running a proof-of-concept that demonstrates measurable productivity gains.

What stays constant: you will be at the centre of the UK's most significant healthcare transformation, working with senior leaders who are making technology decisions that will shape patient care for the next decade. The pace is high, the impact is real, and the team around you is exceptional.

title: Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer, ECAD, Configuration Management
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a software-fluent ECAD Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer to join the Engineering Practice & Configuration Management team. This role mirrors the mechanical domain's custom tooling function-you will build the integration tooling and automation that connects EE design systems (Xpedition, EDM, Teamcenter) into a seamless, reliable configuration management backbone.

You will build the connective tissue between EE's core design systems—Xpedition, EDM, and Teamcenter—creating intelligent automation for IDX exchanges, component synchronization, and BOM reconciliation that eliminates manual handoffs and scales with the program. This will result into a world-class tooling velocity and cross-system reliability for the EE domain.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Custom Integration Tooling: Design, build, and maintain automation that synchronizes data across Xpedition, EDM, and Teamcenter-keeping the 6000+ part component library dimensionally consistent and properly linked across all systems
• BOM Reconciliation Automation: Build tooling that guarantees Teamcenter BOM, Xpedition BOM, and supply-chain BOMs match at design release; enable where-used analysis; flag missing or dropped components; block PCBA release when parts are out of sync or unreleased
• IDX Exchange Improvement: Automate and harden the ECAD-MCAD collaboration workflow (IDX process); implement the validated scheme file as default configuration; build guardrails that prevent protocol deviations that destroy design history
• Build-to-Design Loop Closure: Pull as-built BOM data from supply-chain systems and contract manufacturer red-lines back into engineering tools, enabling true end-to-end data accuracy
• Component Dimensional Integrity Tooling: Build automated verification that detects and prevents dimensional mismatches of component definition between EDM and Teamcenter to enable identification PCBA-to-enclosure fitment failures in CAD and before fabrication
• Release Workflow Automation: Develop release gates and automated checks that enforce component maturity requirements, BOM consistency, and data completeness before PCBA release approval
• Tooling Backlog Ownership: Maintain and prioritize the EE tooling backlog (mirroring mechanical's 47+ item backlog); partner with the EE Configuration Manager to identify highest-impact automation opportunities
• Cross-Domain Integration: Ensure EE tooling integrates cleanly with existing in-house designed mechanical tooling infrastructure for unified cross-domain workflows
• Developer Documentation: Maintain technical documentation for all custom tooling, APIs, and integrations to ensure sustainability and team knowledge transfer

A day in the life
You will be responsible to work across multiple engineering functions to understand the daily pain points of a responsible engineering and translating those into the custom ECAD tools for EE domain.

About the team
The Configuration Management team develops and governs the engineering systems, standards, and processes that ensure spacecraft design data remains accurate, traceable, and controlled throughout the product lifecycle. While the organization originated as a traditional design support function, it has evolved into the engineering authority for product data management and engineering configuration.

The team defines how engineering information flows throughout the digital engineering environment, including Product Lifecycle Management workflows, mechanical and electrical design tool integration, engineering data management, and the interaction between Teamcenter, Siemens NX, Mentor, and other engineering platforms. They also develop tooling and automation that improves engineering productivity while maintaining data integrity across these systems.

In addition to managing engineering data, the organization serves as the company's subject matter experts in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing. They develop engineering standards, mentor design engineers, and promote best practices that improve drawing quality, manufacturability, and technical consistency across the organization.

The team also defines and continuously improves the organization's configuration and change management processes for hardware, requirements, and engineering documentation. They work closely with software organizations to strengthen integrated hardware and software configuration control while ensuring traceability throughout the development lifecycle. Today the organization facilitates Engineering Change Committee and Configuration Control Board activities while actively developing increasingly automated workflows in partnership with the Engineering Information Systems team. These efforts continue moving the organization toward a more efficient, data driven approach to engineering governance.
